cuts.name: Branko
cuts.reason: Conflict: Branko AI (brankoai.com) is a live AI software product with exactly this name. It is a legal research assistant for North Macedonian law, now taking early-access sign-ups. It sits in the Balkan market next to Serbia and in the AI field the company works in, so 'Branko Labs' or 'Branko AI' would collide with it head-on. Secondary problems: the name sounds the same as 'Branco', so it fails the radio test (k or c?). That spelling leads into a crowded BRANCO trademark field (TMview, 4,042 results), including national marks in classes 9 and 42 (Argentina) and 35 (Germany, Greece). Also, Italian 'branco' means herd or pack, and in the news it often means a violent gang.
cuts.reason_sr: Konflikt: Branko AI (brankoai.com) je aktivan AI softverski proizvod sa potpuno istim imenom. To je asistent za pravna istraživanja za pravo Severne Makedonije, trenutno u fazi ranog pristupa. Nalazi se na balkanskom tržištu pored Srbije i u AI oblasti kojom se kompanija bavi, pa bi se „Branko Labs“ ili „Branko AI“ direktno sudarili s njim. Sporedni problemi: ime se izgovara isto kao „Branco“, pa pada radio test (k ili c?). Ta varijanta ulazi u zagušeno polje žigova BRANCO (TMview, 4.042 rezultata), uključujući nacionalne žigove u klasama 9 i 42 (Argentina) i 35 (Nemačka, Grčka). Osim toga, italijansko „branco“ znači krdo ili čopor, a u vestima često označava nasilnu bandu.

Brod.name: Brod
Brod.story: **B**uild, **R**un, **O**wn, **D**eliver. In Serbian and other South Slavic languages 'brod' means ship (and a river ford), so the hidden layer is a local word for the vessel that carries the company's own products out into the world.
Brod.story_sr: **B**uild, **R**un, **O**wn, **D**eliver. „Brod“ je naša reč za plovilo koje nosi robu u svet (i za gaz na reci), pa ime tiho priča priču firme koja gradi i isporučuje sopstvene proizvode.

Keld.name: Keld
Keld.story: **K**eep, **E**volve, **L**aunch, **D**eliver. In northern English dialect a keld is a spring (from Old Norse 'kelda'), and Keld is also a Danish first name, so it suggests a steady source that new products keep flowing from.
Keld.story_sr: **K**eep, **E**volve, **L**aunch, **D**eliver. U severnoengleskom dijalektu 'keld' je izvor, vrelo (od staronordijskog 'kelda'), a Keld je i dansko ime, što odgovara firmi iz koje stalno izviru novi proizvodi.

Garth.name: Garth
Garth.story: **G**row, **A**ssemble, **R**un, **T**end, **H**old. From Old Norse 'garðr', an enclosed yard or garden, it literally means a walled holding where things are grown and kept, and it also reads as a familiar English first name.
Garth.story_sr: **G**row, **A**ssemble, **R**un, **T**end, **H**old. Od staronordijskog 'garðr', ograđeno dvorište ili vrt, dakle doslovno ograđen posed u kome se stvari gaje i čuvaju. U engleskom je i poznato muško ime.

Brock.name: Brock
Brock.story: **B**uild, **R**un, **O**wn, **C**raft, **K**eep. Old English 'brocc' means badger, a patient builder whose setts stay in use for generations, and Brock is also a common surname with the hard Br- sound of the anchors.
Brock.story_sr: **B**uild, **R**un, **O**wn, **C**raft, **K**eep. Staroengleski 'brocc' znači jazavac, strpljivi graditelj čije jazbine koriste generacije. Brock je i često prezime, sa tvrdim Br- zvukom kao kod uzora.

Torben.name: Torben
Torben.story: **T**end, **O**wn, **R**un, **B**uild, **E**volve, **N**urture. A Danish given name from Old Norse 'Þórbjǫrn' ('Thor's bear'), it reads as a person's name the way Brigit does and carries strength without any technology label.
Torben.story_sr: **T**end, **O**wn, **R**un, **B**uild, **E**volve, **N**urture. Dansko ime od staronordijskog 'Þórbjǫrn' („Torov medved“). Zvuči kao ime osobe, kao Brigit, i nosi snagu bez ikakve tehnološke etikete.

Tovar.name: Tovar
Tovar.story: **T**end, **O**wn, **V**alue, **A**ssemble, **R**un. In Slavic languages 'tovar' means cargo or load (in Russian it means goods and merchandise), a quiet nod to a company whose real business is its own products.
Tovar.story_sr: **T**end, **O**wn, **V**alue, **A**ssemble, **R**un. „Tovar“ je kod nas teret, a na ruskom roba, proizvod, što je tiha aluzija na firmu čiji je pravi posao sopstveni proizvod.

Koban.name: Koban
Koban.story: **K**eep, **O**wn, **B**uild, **A**dvance, **N**urture. The koban was the oval gold coin of Edo-period Japan, struck to a trusted standard, so the hidden story is minted, lasting value.
Koban.story_sr: **K**eep, **O**wn, **B**uild, **A**dvance, **N**urture. Koban je ovalni zlatnik iz japanskog Edo perioda, kovan po pouzdanom standardu, pa je skrivena priča o iskovanoj, trajnoj vrednosti.

Torv.name: Torv
Torv.story: **T**end, **O**wn, **R**un, **V**alue. In Danish and Norwegian 'torv' is the market square (as in Copenhagen's Kongens Nytorv), the place where makers bring their own goods to sell.
Torv.story_sr: **T**end, **O**wn, **R**un, **V**alue. Na danskom i norveškom 'torv' je trg, pijaca (kao kopenhaški Kongens Nytorv), mesto gde majstori iznose svoju robu na prodaju.

Brant.name: Brant
Brant.story: **B**uild, **R**un, **A**uthor, **N**urture, **T**end. The brant is a sea goose known for very long migrations, and Brant is also an old German and English surname, giving a sturdy, name-like word with a hard Br- start.
Brant.story_sr: **B**uild, **R**un, **A**uthor, **N**urture, **T**end. Brant je morska guska poznata po veoma dugim seobama, a i staro nemačko i englesko prezime, pa reč zvuči čvrsto i kao ime, sa tvrdim Br- početkom.

Davit.name: Davit
Davit.story: **D**eliver, **A**ssemble, **V**alue, **I**terate, **T**end. A davit is the small crane on a ship that swings boats out and lowers them into the water, a hidden picture of launching products, and it reads like the name David (TMview shows a live German 'davit' mark in class 42, worth checking).
Davit.story_sr: **D**eliver, **A**ssemble, **V**alue, **I**terate, **T**end. Davit je mala dizalica na brodu koja spušta čamce u vodu, skrivena slika lansiranja proizvoda, a čita se kao ime David (TMview pokazuje aktivan nemački žig 'davit' u klasi 42, treba proveriti).

Croft.name: Croft
Croft.story: **C**reate, **R**un, **O**wn, **F**und, **T**end. A croft is a small Scottish landholding that a family both owns and works, a precise metaphor for a small company that owns and runs its own products.
Croft.story_sr: **C**reate, **R**un, **O**wn, **F**und, **T**end. Croft je malo škotsko imanje koje porodica i poseduje i obrađuje, precizna metafora male firme koja poseduje i vodi sopstvene proizvode.

Ashlar.name: Ashlar
Ashlar.story: **A**ssemble, **S**hip, **H**old, **L**aunch, **A**dvance, **R**efine. Ashlar is finely squared, dressed building stone laid in exact courses, a mason's word for careful work that carries weight.
Ashlar.story_sr: **A**ssemble, **S**hip, **H**old, **L**aunch, **A**dvance, **R**efine. Ashlar je fino otesan, pravilno klesan kamen koji se slaže u precizne redove, klesarska reč za pažljiv rad koji nosi težinu.

Sidro.name: Sidro
Sidro.story: **S**hip, **I**terate, **D**eliver, **R**efine, **O**wn. 'Sidro' is Serbian for anchor, a local word that tells the holding-company story: the quiet anchor that keeps several product brands steady.
Sidro.story_sr: **S**hip, **I**terate, **D**eliver, **R**efine, **O**wn. Sidro je prava reč za holding: tiho uporište koje drži više proizvodnih brendova stabilnim, lokalna reč ispričana svetu.

Becket.name: Becket
Becket.story: **B**uild, **E**volve, **C**raft, **K**eep, **E**arn, **T**end. On a ship a becket is a rope loop or eye that holds a line or block in place, and it also reads as a serious English surname (Thomas Becket).
Becket.story_sr: **B**uild, **E**volve, **C**raft, **K**eep, **E**arn, **T**end. Na brodu je becket omča od užeta koja drži konopac ili koloturu na mestu, a čita se i kao ozbiljno englesko prezime (Tomas Beket).

Marek.name: Marek
Marek.story: **M**ake, **A**ssemble, **R**un, **E**arn, **K**eep. The Czech and Polish form of Mark, it sounds like a person's name while hiding the maker's mark a craftsman stamps on finished work.
Marek.story_sr: **M**ake, **A**ssemble, **R**un, **E**arn, **K**eep. Češki i poljski oblik imena Marko. Zvuči kao ime osobe, a krije žig (mark) koji majstor utiskuje na gotov rad.

Radek.name: Radek
Radek.story: **R**un, **A**ssemble, **D**eliver, **E**volve, **K**eep. A Czech and Polish first name built on the Slavic root 'rad', which in Serbian also means work, so the hidden layer is simply honest work.
Radek.story_sr: **R**un, **A**ssemble, **D**eliver, **E**volve, **K**eep. Češko i poljsko ime na slovenskom korenu „rad“, koji kod nas znači i rad, pa je skriveni sloj jednostavno pošten rad.

Hardy.name: Hardy
Hardy.story: **H**old, **A**ssemble, **R**un, **D**eliver, **Y**ield. A hardy is the blacksmith's cutting tool that sits in the square 'hardy hole' of the anvil, and the word also means tough and enduring.
Hardy.story_sr: **H**old, **A**ssemble, **R**un, **D**eliver, **Y**ield. Hardy je kovački alat za sečenje koji se stavlja u četvrtasti otvor nakovnja, a reč znači i izdržljiv, otporan.

Lode.name: Lode
Lode.story: **L**aunch, **O**wn, **D**eliver, **E**volve. A lode is a rich vein of ore in rock (as in 'mother lode'), a short, hard word for lasting value that keeps paying out.
Lode.story_sr: **L**aunch, **O**wn, **D**eliver, **E**volve. Lode je bogata rudna žila u steni (kao u izrazu 'mother lode'), kratka i tvrda reč za trajnu vrednost koja se stalno isplaćuje.

Korb.name: Korb
Korb.story: **K**eep, **O**wn, **R**un, **B**uild. German 'Korb' means basket, a woven craft object that holds many things at once, just as a holding company carries a set of products.
Korb.story_sr: **K**eep, **O**wn, **R**un, **B**uild. Nemačko 'Korb' znači korpa, pleteni zanatski predmet koji drži više stvari odjednom, kao što holding nosi više proizvoda.

Dorn.name: Dorn
Dorn.story: **D**esign, **O**wn, **R**un, **N**urture. In German 'Dorn' is a thorn and, in the metal shop, the mandrel or drift that shapes and holds the work, which gives a short, hard, serious-sounding word.
Dorn.story_sr: **D**esign, **O**wn, **R**un, **N**urture. Na nemačkom 'Dorn' je trn, a u metalskoj radionici trn ili probijač oko koga se oblikuje i drži obradak. Kratka, tvrda i ozbiljna reč.

Branko.name: Branko
Branko.story: **B**uild, **R**un, **A**uthor, **N**urture, **K**eep, **O**wn. A Serbian first name linked to 'braniti' ('to defend'), so it reads like a person, as Brigit does, and quietly means the one who guards what was built.
Branko.story_sr: **B**uild, **R**un, **A**uthor, **N**urture, **K**eep, **O**wn. Srpsko ime vezano za „braniti“, pa zvuči kao osoba, kao Brigit, i tiho znači onaj koji čuva ono što je sagrađeno.

Karst.name: Karst
Karst.story: **K**eep, **A**ssemble, **R**un, **S**hip, **T**end. 'Karst' is the word the world borrowed from the Kras plateau on the Slovenian-Italian border for limestone land carved slowly by water, a regional word gone global just like Mistral (note that several small AI firms already use the name).
Karst.story_sr: **K**eep, **A**ssemble, **R**un, **S**hip, **T**end. „Karst“ je reč koju je svet preuzeo od Krasa, visoravni na slovenačko-italijanskoj granici, za krečnjački reljef koji voda polako oblikuje. To je regionalna reč koja je postala globalna, kao Mistral (ime već koristi nekoliko manjih AI firmi).

Colter.name: Colter
Colter.story: **C**raft, **O**wn, **L**aunch, **T**end, **E**arn, **R**efine. The colter (coulter) is the vertical blade in front of a plough that makes the first clean cut in the soil, and Colter is also an American surname (explorer John Colter).
Colter.story_sr: **C**raft, **O**wn, **L**aunch, **T**end, **E**arn, **R**efine. Colter je vertikalni nož ispred pluga koji pravi prvi čist rez u zemlji, a Colter je i američko prezime (istraživač Džon Kolter).

Berth.name: Berth
Berth.story: **B**uild, **E**arn, **R**un, **T**end, **H**old. A berth is the place in a harbour where a ship is moored and loaded, and 'a wide berth' means a safe margin, which makes it a calm, steady word for a holding company.
Berth.story_sr: **B**uild, **E**arn, **R**un, **T**end, **H**old. Berth je vez u luci gde se brod privezuje i tovari, a 'a wide berth' znači siguran razmak. Mirna i postojana reč za holding.

Tesar.name: Tesar
Tesar.story: **T**end, **E**arn, **S**hip, **A**ssemble, **R**un. 'Tesar' is the Serbian (and Czech) word for the carpenter who hews and joins heavy timber, a local craft word that sounds clean in English.
Tesar.story_sr: **T**end, **E**arn, **S**hip, **A**ssemble, **R**un. Tesar je majstor koji teše i spaja grubo drvo za krovove i konstrukcije, naša zanatska reč koja na engleskom zvuči čisto.

Kontor.name: Kontor
Kontor.story: **K**eep, **O**wn, **N**urture, **T**end, **O**perate, **R**un. A kontor was a Hanseatic League trading house abroad (in London, Bruges, Bergen and Novgorod), a fitting story for a small company that sells its own products across borders.
Kontor.story_sr: **K**eep, **O**wn, **N**urture, **T**end, **O**perate, **R**un. Kontor je bila trgovačka kuća Hanzeatske lige u inostranstvu (London, Brige, Bergen, Novgorod), prikladna priča za malu firmu koja prodaje svoje proizvode preko granica.

Torkel.name: Torkel
Torkel.story: **T**end, **O**wn, **R**un, **K**eep, **E**volve, **L**aunch. A Scandinavian name from Old Norse 'Þorketill' ('Thor's cauldron', a forged vessel), it reads as a person's name with a hard -k- (TMview shows no live US or EU software mark).

Sawbuck.story_sr: Tesarska nogara u obliku slova X, a u američkom slengu novčanica od deset dolara (po rimskom broju X). Zanat i vrednost u jednoj kratkoj, tvrdoj reči.

Goodhew.name: Goodhew
Goodhew.story: A real English surname that reads as 'good hew', to shape wood well with an axe. It sounds like a person's name and carries a quiet craft meaning. The only marks are US and Chinese clothing marks (class 25), and .io, .app, .dev and .ai are free.
Goodhew.story_sr: Pravo englesko prezime koje se čita kao 'good hew', dobro tesati. Zvuči kao ime osobe i nosi tihu zanatsku poruku. Postojeće marke su samo za odeću.

Holdsworth.name: Holdsworth
Holdsworth.story: An English surname that splits into 'hold' + 'worth': a house that holds value. It reads like a founder's name and fits a holding today and an umbrella brand later. All domains are taken.
Holdsworth.story_sr: Englesko prezime koje se čita kao 'hold' + 'worth': kuća koja drži vrednost. Zvuči kao ime osnivača i odgovara holdingu sada i krovnom brendu kasnije.

Kingpost.name: Kingpost
Kingpost.story: The central upright post of a roof truss that carries the ridge and holds the rafters in place. Quiet, structural and central, which is the role of a holding behind its products. All domains are taken.
Kingpost.story_sr: Centralni uspravni stub krovne rešetke koji nosi sleme i drži rogove na mestu. Tih, noseći i centralan, baš kao uloga holdinga iza proizvoda.

Heartwood.name: Heartwood
Heartwood.story: The dense inner core of a tree trunk. It no longer grows, but it is the strongest and most rot-resistant part and what holds the tree up: a quiet core that carries the visible growth.
Heartwood.story_sr: Srž drveta, gusto unutrašnje jezgro stabla. Više ne raste, ali je najčvršći i najotporniji deo koji nosi drvo: tiho jezgro koje drži vidljivi rast.

Whetstone.name: Whetstone
Whetstone.story: The stone you draw a blade across to keep it sharp. It fits a company that keeps its tools (products) keen, and it's a plain, trusted craft word.
Whetstone.story_sr: Brus, kamen za oštrenje sečiva. Odgovara firmi koja svoje alate (proizvode) drži oštrim; jednostavna i poverljiva zanatska reč.

Freestone.name: Freestone
Freestone.story: Fine-grained stone a mason can cut cleanly in any direction without splitting, prized for carving. It suggests the freedom to shape any product from one good material.
Freestone.story_sr: Fino zrnasti kamen koji klesar može čisto da seče u bilo kom pravcu bez pucanja, cenjen za klesanje. Sugeriše slobodu da se od jednog dobrog materijala oblikuje bilo koji proizvod.

Guildhall.name: Guildhall
Guildhall.story: The hall where a town's craft guilds met, set standards and admitted new masters. A house of crafts that can shelter several product brands under one roof.
Guildhall.story_sr: Dom esnafa: zgrada u kojoj su se zanatski cehovi okupljali, postavljali standarde i primali nove majstore. Kuća zanata pod čijim krovom može da stoji više brendova proizvoda.

Seamark.name: Seamark
Seamark.story: A tall landmark or beacon on the coast that sailors steer by. A fixed reference point for products and clients to navigate by.
Seamark.story_sr: Visok obalni orijentir ili znak prema kome mornari drže kurs. Stalna tačka po kojoj se orijentišu proizvodi i klijenti.

Ironside.name: Ironside
Ironside.story: The byname of Edmund Ironside, the 11th-century English king known for stubborn resistance. It reads like a name and sounds hard and dependable. Note: the analytics consultancy Ironside Group uses the name.
Ironside.story_sr: Nadimak Edmunda Ironsajda, engleskog kralja iz 11. veka poznatog po upornom otporu. Čita se kao ime, zvuči čvrsto i pouzdano.

Hayward.name: Hayward
Hayward.story: Old English 'hay' (hedge, enclosure) + 'ward' (guardian): the village officer who kept the fences and guarded the common fields. A guardian of what is owned, and it reads like a surname. Note: Hayward is a well-known pool-equipment brand.
Hayward.story_sr: Staroengleski 'hay' (ograda) + 'ward' (čuvar): seoski službenik koji je čuvao ograde i zajednička polja. Čuvar onoga što je u vlasništvu, a čita se kao prezime. Napomena: Hayward je poznat brend opreme za bazene.

Makepeace.name: Makepeace
Makepeace.story: An English Puritan surname, as in William Makepeace Thackeray, built from 'make' + 'peace'. It reads like a person's name, calm and trustworthy, and 'make' points to building.
Makepeace.story_sr: Englesko puritansko prezime (William Makepeace Thackeray), od 'make' + 'peace'. Čita se kao ime osobe, smireno i pouzdano, a 'make' upućuje na stvaranje.

Crosscut.name: Crosscut
Crosscut.story: The saw that cuts across the grain, the hardest cut in woodworking. Hard k-t sounds and a sense of cutting through a problem. Note: a Seattle news site is called Crosscut.
Crosscut.story_sr: Testera za poprečno sečenje preko vlakana, najteži rez u obradi drveta. Tvrdi k-t zvuci i osećaj probijanja kroz problem.

Firebrick.name: Firebrick
Firebrick.story: Heat-resistant brick that lines kilns and furnaces and takes the heat so the work inside can happen. Hard -br- sound. Note: it is also a CSS color name and a small UK router brand (FireBrick).
Firebrick.story_sr: Šamotna opeka koja oblaže peći i ložišta i podnosi vrelinu da bi posao unutra mogao da se odvija. Napomena: to je i ime CSS boje i malog britanskog brenda rutera (FireBrick).

Drystone.name: Drystone
Drystone.story: In dry-stone walling, stones are chosen and fitted so precisely that the wall stands for centuries with no mortar. The name says the company holds together through craft, not glue. Note: a small UK IT and AI practice, Drystone IT, already uses the name.
Drystone.story_sr: Suvozid (dry stone): kamen se bira i slaže tako precizno da zid vekovima stoji bez maltera. Poruka je da firmu drži zanat, a ne lepak; napomena: mala britanska IT firma Drystone IT već koristi ovo ime.

Kingbolt.name: Kingbolt
Kingbolt.story: The kingbolt is the main vertical bolt on which a carriage's front axle pivots. It is the one part everything else turns on. The name has short, hard sounds (K, B, T) and a clear image of a holding at the center of several products.
Kingbolt.story_sr: Kingbolt je glavni vertikalni zavrtanj oko kog se okreće prednja osovina kočije, deo oko kog se sve okreće. Kratak, tvrd zvuk i jasna slika holdinga u središtu više proizvoda.

Masonmark.name: Masonmark
Masonmark.story: A mason's mark is the personal sign a stonemason cut into every stone he dressed, so his work could be traced and paid for. Cathedrals still carry these marks. The name means signing your own work, which suits a company moving to its own products.
Masonmark.story_sr: Klesarski znak je lični simbol koji je klesar urezivao u svaki kamen koji je obradio, da bi se znalo čiji je rad; katedrale ih i danas nose. Znači potpisati sopstveni rad, što odgovara firmi koja prelazi na svoje proizvode.

Rooftree.name: Rooftree
Rooftree.story: Rooftree is an old English word for the ridge beam of a roof. By extension it also means the home or household under that roof. It makes a quiet holding name: one roof over several product houses.
Rooftree.story_sr: Stara engleska reč za slemenjaču, glavnu gredu krova, a u prenesenom značenju i za dom i domaćinstvo pod njim. Tiho holding ime: jedan krov nad više proizvoda.

Mainmast.name: Mainmast
Mainmast.story: The mainmast is a ship's principal mast and carries the largest sails. It works well as a later umbrella brand ('Quicktalog by Mainmast'). A finance firm, Mainmast Capital, also uses the name.
Mainmast.story_sr: Glavni jarbol broda koji nosi najveća jedra. Kasnije dobro radi kao krovni brend ('Quicktalog by Mainmast'); finansijska firma Mainmast Capital takođe koristi ime.

Bellcast.name: Bellcast
Bellcast.story: A bell is cast in a single pour with no second chance: the alloy and the mould must be right, and the tone is then fixed forever. In architecture, bellcast eaves flare out like a bell. The name carries precision and a sound that rings.
Bellcast.story_sr: Livenje zvona je jedno livenje bez druge šanse: legura i kalup moraju biti tačni, a ton ostaje zauvek. U arhitekturi je 'bellcast' streha raširena kao zvono; ime nosi preciznost i zvuk koji odzvanja.

Drawbore.name: Drawbore
Drawbore.story: In a drawbore joint the peg hole is slightly offset, so driving the peg in pulls the joint tighter. Timber frames joined this way have stood for centuries without glue. The hidden story is that well-placed tension makes the whole stronger.
Drawbore.story_sr: Kod drawbore spoja rupa za klin se malo pomeri, pa zakucavanje klina sam spoj pritegne; drvene konstrukcije spojene ovako stoje vekovima bez lepka. Skrivena priča: dobro postavljena napetost čini celinu jačom.

Ironbloom.name: Ironbloom
Ironbloom.story: In early bloomery furnaces, ore was reduced to a spongy lump of iron called a bloom. That bloom was the raw stock a smith then forged into tools. The name tells of raw material becoming products, and 'bloom' also hints at growth.
Ironbloom.story_sr: U starim pećima (bloomery) ruda se pretvarala u sunđerastu grudvu gvožđa zvanu 'bloom', sirovinu od koje kovač kuje alat. Sirovina koja postaje proizvod, a 'bloom' (cvetanje) nagoveštava rast.

Sternpost.name: Sternpost
Sternpost.story: The sternpost is the main upright timber at a ship's stern, and it carries the rudder. The sternpost rudder is what made it possible to steer large ships. The name fits a holding that steers several products, and 'stern' also reads as serious.
Sternpost.story_sr: Krmena statva je glavna uspravna greda na krmi broda koja nosi kormilo; upravo je kormilo na krmenoj statvi omogućilo upravljanje velikim brodovima. Odgovara holdingu koji usmerava više proizvoda, a 'stern' zvuči i ozbiljno.

Goldbeater.name: Goldbeater
Goldbeater.story: A goldbeater hammers gold into leaf about a ten-thousandth of a millimetre thick, a craft practised since ancient Egypt. The name suggests patient skill that spreads a little value across a lot of surface.
Goldbeater.story_sr: Goldbeater je majstor koji zlato kuje u listiće debele oko desethiljaditog dela milimetra, zanat poznat još od starog Egipta. Nagoveštava strpljivu veštinu koja malo vrednosti pretvori u mnogo površine.

Sheerline.name: Sheerline
Sheerline.story: In boatbuilding, the sheer line is the curve of the deck edge from bow to stern, and builders say it makes or breaks a boat's looks. The name stands for craft and clean design. A UK aluminium window brand, Sheerline, already uses it.
Sheerline.story_sr: U brodogradnji 'sheer line' je linija ivice palube od pramca do krme; graditelji kažu da ona odlučuje da li je brod lep. Zanat i čist dizajn; britanski brend aluminijumskih prozora Sheerline koristi ovo ime.

Cropmark.name: Cropmark
Cropmark.story: Cropmarks are patterns in fields, visible from the air, that reveal buried walls and foundations. In printing, crop marks show where a sheet is trimmed. The name combines hidden structure made visible with a precise finish.
Cropmark.story_sr: Cropmark su tragovi u usevima, vidljivi iz vazduha, koji otkrivaju zakopane zidove i temelje; u štampi su to oznake za sečenje tabaka. Skrivena struktura koja postaje vidljiva i precizna završnica.

Crownwheel.name: Crownwheel
Crownwheel.story: A crown wheel is a gear whose teeth stand up like a crown and turn motion through a right angle. It sits at the heart of clocks and car differentials. The name suggests a precise central mechanism that drives the parts around it.
Crownwheel.story_sr: Tanjirasti zupčanik (crown wheel) ima zupce podignute kao kruna i prenosi pokret pod pravim uglom; nalazi se u srcu satova i diferencijala automobila. Precizan centralni mehanizam koji pokreće delove oko sebe.

Trysquare.name: Trysquare
Trysquare.story: A try square is the carpenter's tool for testing ('trying') that an edge is exactly 90 degrees. Quality control is built into the name: everything is checked true before it ships.
Trysquare.story_sr: Try square je stolarski ugaonik kojim se proverava ('try') da li je ivica tačno pod 90 stepeni. Kontrola kvaliteta ugrađena u ime: sve se proveri pre isporuke.

Keelblock.name: Keelblock
Keelblock.story: Keel blocks are the heavy blocks a ship rests on while it is built or repaired in dry dock. The name is the quiet foundation under every product, with hard K-B-K sounds.
Keelblock.story_sr: Kobilični blokovi su teški blokovi na kojima brod leži dok se gradi ili popravlja u suvom doku. Tihi temelj ispod svakog proizvoda, uz tvrde glasove K-B-K.

Hawsepipe.name: Hawsepipe
Hawsepipe.story: The hawsepipe is the pipe in a ship's bow that the anchor chain runs through. A captain who 'came up through the hawsepipe' rose from deckhand through experience rather than an academy. That fits a self-built company that earned its way to its own products. A small maritime training site uses hawsepipe.net.
Hawsepipe.story_sr: Hawsepipe je cev na pramcu kroz koju prolazi sidreni lanac; za kapetana koji je 'došao kroz hawsepipe' kaže se da se od mornara uzdigao iskustvom, a ne školom. Odgovara firmi koja je sama izgradila put do sopstvenih proizvoda; mali sajt za pomorsku obuku koristi hawsepipe.net.

Tiebeam.name: Tiebeam
Tiebeam.story: A tie beam is the horizontal timber that ties the feet of the rafters together so the roof cannot spread. That is literally what a holding does: it holds separate parts together. Note: a tech investment firm already uses the name TIEBEAM.
Tiebeam.story_sr: Tiebeam je vodoravna greda koja spaja donje krajeve rogova da se krov ne raširi. Bukvalno ono što holding radi, drži odvojene delove na okupu; napomena: tehnološka investiciona firma koristi ime TIEBEAM.

Crownglass.name: Crownglass
Crownglass.story: Crown glass was blown and then spun by hand into a wide disc, the craft that glazed Europe's windows for centuries. The name suggests craft and clarity, and 'crown' hints at a lead brand. Some auto-glass shops use the name 'Crown Glass'.
Crownglass.story_sr: Crown staklo se ručno duvalo i okretanjem razvlačilo u širok disk, zanat koji je vekovima zastakljivao prozore Evrope. Zanat i providnost, a 'crown' nagoveštava vodeći brend; neke radnje za auto-stakla koriste 'Crown Glass'.

Firesteel.name: Firesteel
Firesteel.story: A firesteel is the piece of hardened steel struck against flint to throw the spark that lights a fire. It stands for the spark that starts products. Note: a small US custom-software firm, FireSteel Technologies, already uses the name.
Firesteel.story_sr: Ocilo (firesteel) je komad kaljenog čelika kojim se udara o kremen da bi se dobila varnica. Iskra iz koje nastaju proizvodi; napomena: postoji mala američka softverska firma FireSteel Technologies.

Bowsprit.name: Bowsprit
Bowsprit.story: The bowsprit is the spar that projects forward from a ship's bow and anchors the foresails, so it is always the first part to arrive. It is a forward-looking name. A US compliance consultancy uses the name Bowsprit Solutions.
Bowsprit.story_sr: Kosnik (bowsprit) je motka koja strši ispred pramca broda i drži prednja jedra; uvek prvi stiže. Ime koje gleda napred; američka konsultantska firma koristi ime Bowsprit Solutions.

Seedcorn.name: Seedcorn
Seedcorn.story: Seed corn is the grain a farmer keeps back rather than eats, so it can be planted for next year's harvest. In English it is a metaphor for investing in the future. It fits putting service income back into the company's own products, though several seed-funding programmes use the word.
Seedcorn.story_sr: Seme za setvu (seed corn) je žito koje seljak ne pojede nego ga čuva za sledeću žetvu; u engleskom je metafora za ulaganje u budućnost. Odgovara ulaganju prihoda od usluga u sopstvene proizvode, iako nekoliko fondova za startape koristi ovu reč.

Wheelwork.name: Wheelwork
Wheelwork.story: Wheelwork is the train of gears inside a clock that turns stored energy into accurate time. Several parts mesh as one system, like a holding with several products.
Wheelwork.story_sr: Wheelwork je niz zupčanika u satu koji uskladištenu energiju pretvara u tačno vreme. Više delova koji rade kao jedan sistem, kao holding sa više proizvoda.

pending_screen.story_sr: Crown staklo se ručno duvalo i okretanjem razvlačilo u širok disk, zanat koji je vekovima zastakljivao prozore Evrope. Zanat i providnost, a 'crown' nagoveštava vodeći brend; neke radnje za auto-stakla koriste 'Crown Glass'.

pending_screen.name: Firesteel
pending_screen.story: A firesteel is the piece of hardened steel struck against flint to throw the spark that lights a fire. It stands for the spark that starts products. Note: a small US custom-software firm, FireSteel Technologies, already uses the name.
pending_screen.story_sr: Ocilo (firesteel) je komad kaljenog čelika kojim se udara o kremen da bi se dobila varnica. Iskra iz koje nastaju proizvodi; napomena: postoji mala američka softverska firma FireSteel Technologies.

pending_screen.name: Bowsprit
pending_screen.story: The bowsprit is the spar that projects forward from a ship's bow and anchors the foresails, so it is always the first part to arrive. It is a forward-looking name. A US compliance consultancy uses the name Bowsprit Solutions.
pending_screen.story_sr: Kosnik (bowsprit) je motka koja strši ispred pramca broda i drži prednja jedra; uvek prvi stiže. Ime koje gleda napred; američka konsultantska firma koristi ime Bowsprit Solutions.

pending_screen.name: Seedcorn
pending_screen.story: Seed corn is the grain a farmer keeps back rather than eats, so it can be planted for next year's harvest. In English it is a metaphor for investing in the future. It fits putting service income back into the company's own products, though several seed-funding programmes use the word.
pending_screen.story_sr: Seme za setvu (seed corn) je žito koje seljak ne pojede nego ga čuva za sledeću žetvu; u engleskom je metafora za ulaganje u budućnost. Odgovara ulaganju prihoda od usluga u sopstvene proizvode, iako nekoliko fondova za startape koristi ovu reč.

pending_screen.name: Wheelwork
pending_screen.story: Wheelwork is the train of gears inside a clock that turns stored energy into accurate time. Several parts mesh as one system, like a holding with several products.
pending_screen.story_sr: Wheelwork je niz zupčanika u satu koji uskladištenu energiju pretvara u tačno vreme. Više delova koji rade kao jedan sistem, kao holding sa više proizvoda.

kept.story_sr: Javor (pisano Yavor) je drvo od kog se prave violine i gitare zbog rezonance, a ujedno je muško ime i planina u Srbiji. Zvuči kao ime osobe, sa skrivenom pričom o finom materijalu i zanatu.

Zavar.name: Zavar
Zavar.story: Serbian for a weld seam (zavariti = to weld), the strongest joint in metalwork. It tells the same hidden joining story as Braze in a word of its own: a company that fuses its own products and client work into one solid piece.
Zavar.story_sr: Zavar je spoj dva metala nastao zavarivanjem (zavariti), najjači spoj u obradi metala. Ista skrivena priča o spajanju kao kod Braze, ali u sopstvenoj reči: firma koja čvrsto spaja svoje proizvode i rad za klijente.

Okvir.name: Okvir
Okvir.story: Serbian for frame, and also the word Serbian developers use for a software framework. It has a hard K, opens with 'OK', and says exactly what a holding is: the frame that holds several products together.
Okvir.story_sr: Okvir je ram, a u programiranju i reč za framework. Tvrdo K, počinje sa 'OK' i kaže tačno šta je holding: okvir koji drži više proizvoda na okupu.

Kalup.name: Kalup
Kalup.story: Serbian for a mould or casting form (from Turkish kalıp). Molten metal is poured into it so that every piece comes out true, which suits a company whose products are cast from one proven pattern.
Kalup.story_sr: Kalup je forma za livenje (tur. kalıp) u koju se uliva metal, pa svaki komad izađe isti i tačan. Pristaje firmi čiji proizvodi nastaju iz jednog proverenog kalupa.

Brodar.name: Brodar
Brodar.story: Serbian for a shipbuilder or boatman (brod = ship). It opens with the hard Br- the founder likes and tells a builder-and-navigator story: a fleet of products under one flag.
Brodar.story_sr: Brodar je onaj ko gradi ili vodi brodove (brod). Počinje tvrdim Br- koje se osnivaču dopada i nosi priču o graditelju i moreplovcu: flota proizvoda pod jednom zastavom.

Krov.name: Krov
Krov.story: Serbian for roof. It is one hard syllable, and the meaning is the brand architecture itself: a single roof over several products, e.g. 'Quicktalog, a Krov company'.
Krov.story_sr: Krov je ono što pokriva i štiti kuću. Jedan tvrd slog, a značenje je sama arhitektura brenda: jedan krov nad više proizvoda, npr. 'Quicktalog, a Krov company'.

Brus.name: Brus
Brus.story: Serbian for whetstone, the stone that keeps every blade sharp (brusiti = to hone). One hard Br- syllable that sounds like the name Bruce. It is the quiet tool behind every sharp edge, the way a holding stands behind its products.
Brus.story_sr: Brus je kamen za oštrenje (brusiti). Jedan tvrd slog sa Br- koji zvuči kao ime Bruce; tihi alat iza svake oštre ivice, kao holding iza svojih proizvoda.

Kalem.name: Kalem
Kalem.story: Serbian for a graft or scion: the cutting joined onto a rootstock so the tree bears better fruit. Through Turkish kalem it also means pen. The double story is about joining and writing, with new products grafted onto one strong root.
Kalem.story_sr: Kalem je mladica koja se kalemi na podlogu da bi voćka bolje rađala, a preko turskog kalem znači i pero. Dvostruka priča o spajanju i pisanju: novi proizvodi nakalemljeni na jedan jak koren.

Izvor.name: Izvor
Izvor.story: Serbian for a spring or source, the place where a river begins. It is also the everyday word for 'source' in source code (izvorni kod). A calm, strong origin story for a company that makes its own products.
Izvor.story_sr: Izvor je mesto gde reka počinje, a izvorni kod je source code. Mirna i jaka priča o poreklu za firmu koja pravi sopstvene proizvode.

Tezga.name: Tezga
Tezga.story: Serbian for a workbench or market stall (from Turkish tezgah, a workbench or loom): the place where a craftsman both makes and sells, which are exactly a product company's two jobs. In Serbian slang it also means a side gig, but that matters little outside Serbia.
Tezga.story_sr: Tezga je radni sto i prodajni štand (tur. tezgah): mesto gde majstor i pravi i prodaje, a to su upravo dva posla firme sa sopstvenim proizvodima. U žargonu znači i honorarni posao, što van Srbije ne smeta.

Stega.name: Stega
Stega.story: Serbian for a clamp or vise (stegnuti = to tighten), the tool that holds pieces firmly while glue or a weld sets. The word also means discipline. It is a literal holding: it keeps its products steady.
Stega.story_sr: Stega je stolarska stezaljka koja čvrsto drži delove dok se lepak ili var ne stegne (stegnuti), a znači i disciplinu. Doslovan holding: drži svoje proizvode čvrsto na mestu.

Zalog.name: Zalog
Zalog.story: Serbian for a pledge, stake or collateral: what you put on the line for something you believe in. A holding that owns its products has its stake in them, and the 'log' inside the word is a small nod to software.
Zalog.story_sr: Zalog je ono što daješ kao garanciju za nešto u šta veruješ. Holding koji poseduje svoje proizvode ima svoj zalog u njima, a 'log' u reči je mali softverski mig.

Sidro.name: Sidro
Sidro.story: Serbian for anchor. A holding is literally what anchors a group of products. Two short syllables that English speakers can say easily.
Sidro.story_sr: Sidro drži brod na mestu, a holding je upravo ono što drži grupu proizvoda na okupu. Dva kratka sloga, lako izgovorljivo na engleskom.

Kormilo.name: Kormilo
Kormilo.story: Serbian for a helm or rudder, the part that steers the whole ship. It suits a holding that quietly steers its product brands while staying out of sight.
Kormilo.story_sr: Kormilo je deo broda kojim se upravlja celim plovilom. Pristaje holdingu koji tiho usmerava brendove proizvoda, a sam ostaje u pozadini.

Klesar.name: Klesar
Klesar.story: Serbian for stonemason (klesati = to carve stone). Its hard K-L-S sound is close to 'Kaiser', and the story is patient precision: cutting things that last.
Klesar.story_sr: Klesar je majstor koji kleše kamen (klesati). Tvrdi glasovi K-L-S, blizu 'Kaiser'; priča o strpljivoj preciznosti i pravljenju onoga što traje.

Tesar.name: Tesar
Tesar.story: Serbian for a carpenter who hews beams and frames roofs (tesati = to hew). It is short and hard and sounds like a surname. In Spanish 'tesar' means to pull taut, which fits builders of load-bearing structure.
Tesar.story_sr: Tesar je majstor koji teše grede i podiže krovne konstrukcije (tesati). Kratko, tvrdo, zvuči kao prezime, a na španskom 'tesar' znači zategnuti: graditelji noseće konstrukcije.

Kolar.name: Kolar
Kolar.story: Serbian for wheelwright, the craftsman who made wheels and carts (kolo = wheel). It is a common Slavic surname, so it reads like a person's name, and its hidden story is building the thing that makes everything else move.
Kolar.story_sr: Kolar je majstor koji pravi točkove i kola (kolo). Često slovensko prezime, pa zvuči kao ime osobe, sa skrivenom pričom o pravljenju onoga što sve ostalo pokreće.

Dabar.name: Dabar
Dabar.story: Serbian for beaver, nature's engineer, which builds dams and lodges that outlast the seasons. It has a hard D and B, sounds like a name, and tells the story of a patient builder.
Dabar.story_sr: Dabar je prirodni inženjer koji gradi brane i nastambe koje traju godinama. Tvrdo D i B, zvuči kao ime, sa pričom o strpljivom graditelju.

Yavor.name: Yavor
Yavor.story: English spelling of Serbian javor, the maple, whose tonewood gives violins and guitars their resonance. It is also a South Slavic man's name and a Serbian mountain. It reads like a person's name, with a hidden story of fine material and craft.
Yavor.story_sr: Javor (pisano Yavor) je drvo od kog se prave violine i gitare zbog rezonance, a ujedno je muško ime i planina u Srbiji. Zvuči kao ime osobe, sa skrivenom pričom o finom materijalu i zanatu.

Trajan.name: Trajan
Trajan.story: A Serbian adjective meaning lasting or durable. It is also the name of the Roman emperor whose Tabula Traiana and bridge remains still stand on the Danube in Serbia's Iron Gates. Like Adacta it is a serious old root, and it means built to last.
Trajan.story_sr: Trajan znači dugotrajan i postojan, a ujedno je ime cara Trajana, čija tabla i ostaci mosta i danas stoje na Dunavu u Đerdapu. Ozbiljan stari koren kao Adacta, sa značenjem 'napravljeno da traje'.

Vinca.name: Vinca
Vinca.story: English-friendly spelling of Vinča, the Neolithic culture on the Danube near Belgrade. Its sites show some of the world's earliest copper smelting and early proto-writing symbols, so the story is people who have been making things since the very beginning. 'Vinca' already exists in English as the periwinkle plant.
Vinca.story_sr: Vinča je neolitska kultura na Dunavu kod Beograda, sa nekim od najranijih tragova topljenja bakra na svetu i ranim znakovima protopisma. Priča o ljudima koji stvaraju od samog početka, a reč Vinca već postoji u engleskom kao ime biljke zimzelen.

Mustra.name: Mustra
Mustra.story: Serbian for a pattern, template or sample (from German Muster), like a tailor's or embroiderer's pattern. It suits a product company whose tools, like Quicktalog, turn one good template into many results.
Mustra.story_sr: Mustra je šablon ili uzorak (od nem. Muster), kao krojačka ili vezilačka mustra. Pristaje firmi čiji proizvodi, poput Quicktaloga, od jedne dobre mustre prave mnogo rezultata.

Stablo.name: Stablo
Stablo.story: Serbian for a tree or trunk, and also the Serbian term for a tree data structure in computer science. One trunk with many branches is a natural picture of a holding with product brands growing out of it.
Stablo.story_sr: Stablo je drvo, deblo, a u računarstvu i struktura podataka. Jedno deblo, mnogo grana: prirodna slika holdinga iz kog rastu brendovi proizvoda.

Merilo.name: Merilo
Merilo.story: Serbian for a yardstick, gauge or standard (meriti = to measure). The story is about setting the standard that others are measured against.
Merilo.story_sr: Merilo je mera, kriterijum, standard (meriti). Priča o postavljanju standarda po kome se drugi mere.

Uzor.name: Uzor
Uzor.story: Serbian for a model or exemplar: the example others follow. To English ears it sounds like 'user', a quiet nod to software without saying so.
Uzor.story_sr: Uzor je primer koji drugi slede. Na engleskom zvuči kao 'user', tih mig ka softveru bez direktnog pominjanja.

Kovan.name: Kovan
Kovan.story: Serbian for 'forged', the past participle of kovati (to forge). The word describes something finished and hammered into shape: things that were made, not bought.
Kovan.story_sr: Kovan znači iskovan, od glagola kovati. Reč za nešto završeno i uobličeno čekićem: stvari koje su napravljene, a ne kupljene.

Oblik.name: Oblik
Oblik.story: Serbian for form or shape. It is short and hard, echoes 'oblique' in English, and names the craft of giving ideas a shape.
Oblik.story_sr: Oblik je forma, izgled stvari. Kratko i tvrdo, podseća na engleski 'oblique' i imenuje zanat davanja oblika idejama.

Rende.name: Rende
Rende.story: Serbian for a carpenter's hand plane (from Turkish rende), the tool that makes a board true and smooth. It echoes 'render' in English, and in Italian 'rende' means 'it yields'.
Rende.story_sr: Rende je stolarski alat kojim se daska ravna i glača (tur. rende). Podseća na engleski 'render', a na italijanskom 'rende' znači 'donosi, daje'.

Plamen.name: Plamen
Plamen.story: Serbian for flame, and also a common South Slavic man's name. Like Brigit, it reads like a person, and behind it is the story of a forge fire.
Plamen.story_sr: Plamen je vatra u kovačnici, a i često južnoslovensko muško ime. Kao Brigit, zvuči kao ime osobe, a iza njega stoji priča o vatri u kovačnici.

kept.name: Kersey
kept.tm_note: TMview contains-search returned 23 results. None is a live KERSEY mark in class 9, 35 or 42 at USPTO, EUIPO, WIPO or Serbia. The only USPTO KERSEY in class 9 (Figgie International, classes 9/12) has ended. The closest live marks: 'KATERINA KERSEY DESIGN' (WIPO and CZ, classes 35/41/42/45; it combines a designer's personal name with the word), 'Kersey Guitars' (a UK filing in classes 9/15/37, UK only) and an Indian KERSEY in class 25. Serbia shows no marks.
kept.conflict_note: Two searches found no software, tech, AI, app or dev-studio brand named Kersey. The closest are small professional firms: Kersey Communications (a one-person comms consultancy) and Kersey, Scott & Associates (listed on Clutch). There are also the towns of Kersey in Colorado and Pennsylvania and many people with the surname, such as Kris Kersey (maker) and David Kersey (creative director). Outside tech, Paul Kersey is the vigilante hero of the Death Wish films.
kept.language_note: In English, kersey is a hard-wearing woollen cloth and also a surname. No negative meaning or homophone turned up in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian or Hungarian (French and Italian have their own words for the cloth). In Serbian it has no meaning. There is a weak echo of colloquial 'ker' (dog, mildly pejorative), but Serbia is not a target market. The Death Wish link (Paul Kersey) is minor.
kept.story: Kersey is a coarse, hard-wearing woollen cloth named after the village of Kersey in Suffolk and exported across Europe from the Middle Ages. The story is a small place making a durable product for the world, like a Serbian team exporting software. It reads like a surname.
kept.story_sr: Kersey je gruba, izdržljiva vunena tkanina nazvana po selu Kersey u Safoku, izvožena širom Evrope od srednjeg veka. Priča je o malom mestu koje pravi trajan proizvod za ceo svet, kao srpski tim koji izvozi softver; zvuči kao prezime.
kept.risk: Kept: nothing concrete disqualifies it. The main risk is a crowded surname namespace. The closest same-name software business is Kersey, Scott & Associates, a one-person custom software developer in Phoenix, and many tech professionals are named Kersey (Richard Kersey, founder of Chirper; Kris Kersey; Jesse Kersey of Apex Lab), so owning search results will be hard. The radio test is only borderline: people may say KER-zee or KER-see and spell it Kearsey, Kirsey or Kursey, though the 'Jersey' pattern helps. Two searches found no software, SaaS, AI or tech product brand, and TMview shows no live KERSEY mark in classes 9, 35 or 42. The soft '-sey' ending is also weaker than the short, hard sound the founder wants.
kept.risk_sr: Zadržano: ništa konkretno ga ne diskvalifikuje. Glavni rizik je prenatrpan prostor prezimena. Najbliži istoimeni softverski posao je Kersey, Scott & Associates, jednočlani razvijač softvera po meri iz Finiksa, a mnogi ljudi u tehnologiji se prezivaju Kersey (Richard Kersey, osnivač Chirper-a; Kris Kersey; Jesse Kersey iz Apex Lab-a), pa će biti teško zauzeti rezultate pretrage. Radio test je samo granično prošao: ljudi mogu izgovoriti KER-zi ili KER-si i napisati Kearsey, Kirsey ili Kursey, mada analogija sa 'Jersey' pomaže. Dve pretrage nisu našle nijedan softverski, SaaS, AI ili tehnološki brend proizvoda, a TMview ne pokazuje nijedan živ žig KERSEY u klasama 9, 35 ili 42. Mekši završetak '-sey' je slabiji od kratkog i tvrdog zvuka koji osnivač želi.

Tenon.name: Tenon
Tenon.story: In joinery the tenon is the tongue cut on the end of a timber that locks into a mortise. Mortise-and-tenon joints have held furniture and timber frames together for centuries without nails. It suits a company whose products fit tightly into its clients' businesses.
Tenon.story_sr: U stolarstvu tenon je čep na kraju grede koji ulazi u žleb (mortise), a taj spoj vekovima drži nameštaj i drvene konstrukcije bez eksera. Ime pristaje firmi čiji se proizvodi precizno uklapaju u poslovanje klijenata.

Cupel.name: Cupel
Cupel.story: A cupel is the small porous dish assayers used to test gold and silver. The base metals soak into it and only the pure precious metal is left. The story is about testing everything and keeping only what is valuable.
Cupel.story_sr: Kupela je mala porozna posuda u kojoj su probirači proveravali zlato i srebro: bezvredni metali se upiju, a ostaje samo čist plemeniti metal. Priča je o proveri i zadržavanju samo onoga što vredi.

Croft.name: Croft
Croft.story: A croft is a small Scottish landholding that its crofter works independently, making a living from their own work rather than an empire. That fits a small company living off its own products. It is one hard syllable that echoes 'craft' and reads like a surname.
Croft.story_sr: Croft je malo škotsko imanje koje krofter samostalno obrađuje i živi od sopstvenog rada. To odgovara maloj firmi koja živi od sopstvenih proizvoda. Jedan je tvrd slog koji podseća na 'craft' i zvuči kao prezime.

Recto.name: Recto
Recto.story: In printing and bookbinding the recto is the right-hand front side of a leaf, the page you see first (the verso is the back). The name is about putting your own work on the front page. It has the hard -ct- sound the founder likes.
Recto.story_sr: U štampi i knjigovezaštvu recto je desna, prednja strana lista, stranica koja se prva vidi (verso je poleđina). Ime govori o sopstvenom radu koji stoji na prvoj strani, a ima tvrdo -ct- koje osnivač voli.

Platen.name: Platen
Platen.story: The platen is the heavy flat plate of a printing press (and later the roller of a typewriter). It presses paper evenly onto the type and turns set letters into a finished page. The story is steady pressure that turns work into a product.
Platen.story_sr: Platen je teška ravna ploča štamparske prese (kasnije valjak pisaće mašine) koja ravnomerno pritiska papir na slog i pretvara složena slova u gotovu stranu. Priča je o postojanom pritisku koji rad pretvara u proizvod.

Davit.name: Davit
Davit.story: A davit is the small crane on a ship's side that lifts and launches its boats, so a ship can put smaller craft into the water anywhere. It is a natural metaphor for a holding that launches products. It also reads like a person's name.
Davit.story_sr: Davit je mala dizalica na boku broda koja podiže i spušta čamce, pa brod može da porine manja plovila bilo gde. Prirodna je metafora za holding koji porinjava proizvode, a zvuči i kao lično ime.

Ashlar.name: Ashlar
Ashlar.story: Ashlar is finely squared, dressed stone laid in exact courses. It is the stone of cathedrals and banks, the opposite of rough rubble. The story is precise building blocks that make lasting structures, and it sounds like a surname.
Ashlar.story_sr: Ašlar je fino otesan pravougaoni kamen slagan u precizne redove, kamen katedrala i banaka, suprotnost lomljenom kamenu. Priča je o preciznim gradivnim blokovima za trajne građevine, a zvuči kao prezime.

Fuller.name: Fuller
Fuller.story: A fuller is both a blacksmith's rounded forging tool and the groove it forges along a sword blade. The groove makes the blade lighter without making it weaker. The story is lean but strong, like a small team with strong products, and it reads like a surname (Buckminster Fuller).
Fuller.story_sr: Fuller je kovački alat i žleb koji se njime iskuje duž sečiva mača, pa sečivo postaje lakše, a ne slabije. Priča je o malom timu sa jakim proizvodima, a zvuči i kao prezime (Buckminster Fuller).

Hawser.name: Hawser
Hawser.story: A hawser is the thick cable used to moor or tow a ship, the line that holds a vessel to port. The story is a strong line clients can tie to. It ends in a -zer sound like Braze and reads like the surname Hauser.
Hawser.story_sr: Hawser je debelo brodsko uže kojim se brod vezuje za obalu ili vuče, konopac koji drži brod u luci. Priča je o čvrstoj vezi za koju se klijenti vezuju. Završava se na -zer kao Braze i zvuči kao prezime Hauser.

Tombac.name: Tombac
Tombac.story: Tombac is a copper-zinc alloy with a warm gold color, prized for medals, buttons and ornaments. The word comes from the Malay 'tembaga' (copper). The story is a metal made to look and last like gold, in two hard syllables.
Tombac.story_sr: Tombak je legura bakra i cinka toplog zlatnog sjaja, cenjena za medalje, dugmad i ukrase, a reč potiče od malajskog 'tembaga' (bakar). Priča je o metalu koji izgleda i traje kao zlato, u dva tvrda sloga.

Detent.name: Detent
Detent.story: A detent is the catch in a clock or marine chronometer that holds a wheel still and releases it at exactly the right moment (the 'detent escapement'). The story is precise control and timing. It has a clean, serious enterprise feel.
Detent.story_sr: Detent je zapinjač u satu ili brodskom hronometru koji drži točak i pušta ga u tačno pravom trenutku (hronometarski 'detent' zakočni mehanizam). Priča je o preciznoj kontroli i tajmingu, uz čist, ozbiljan korporativni utisak.

Octavo.name: Octavo
Octavo.story: An octavo is a book made by folding each printed sheet three times into eight leaves. It was the portable format that made books everyday objects. The story is one sheet, many pages: one company, many products. It has the -ct- sound.
Octavo.story_sr: Oktavo je knjiga kod koje se svaki štampani tabak savije tri puta u osam listova, prenosiv format koji je knjigu učinio svakodnevnim predmetom. Priča je o jednom tabaku i mnogo stranica: jedna firma, mnogo proizvoda.

Bulwark.name: Bulwark
Bulwark.story: The bulwark is the raised side of a ship above the deck that keeps crew and cargo aboard; by extension it means any strong defence. The story is a protective hull around the products. It has a weighty, serious enterprise feel.
Bulwark.story_sr: Bulwark je uzdignuta ograda broda iznad palube koja čuva posadu i teret, a u prenesenom smislu svaki čvrst bedem. Priča je o zaštitnom trupu oko proizvoda, uz težak, ozbiljan korporativni utisak.

Buckram.name: Buckram
Buckram.story: Buckram is the stiff, glue-sized cloth bookbinders use to cover library and law books so they survive decades of handling. The story is the durable binding that makes a product last. It has hard B and K consonants.
Buckram.story_sr: Bakram je kruto platno impregnirano lepkom kojim knjigovesci povezuju bibliotečke i pravne knjige da izdrže decenije korišćenja. Priča je o izdržljivom povezu koji proizvod čini trajnim, a ima tvrde suglasnike B i K.

Alidade.name: Alidade
Alidade.story: The alidade is the sighting rule on an astrolabe or a surveyor's plane table. It is used to aim at a distant point and plot it exactly; the word comes from the Arabic al-idada. The story is seeing where to go and mapping it with rigor.
Alidade.story_sr: Alidada je vizirni lenjir na astrolabu ili geodetskom stolu kojim se nišani udaljena tačka i tačno ucrtava (od arapskog al-idada). Priča je o tome da se vidi kuda se ide i da se to precizno izmeri.

Pelorus.name: Pelorus
Pelorus.story: A pelorus is a navigation instrument for taking bearings. It is named after Pelorus, said to have been Hannibal's pilot. The story is keeping your bearings true, with a classical root like Adacta.
Pelorus.story_sr: Pelorus je navigacioni instrument za merenje pravca (azimuta), nazvan po Pelorusu, prema predanju Hanibalovom kormilaru. Priča je o održavanju pravog kursa, sa klasičnim korenom kao Adacta.

Cordovan.name: Cordovan
Cordovan.story: Cordovan is a dense, long-lasting leather named after Cordoba, whose leatherworkers were famous across medieval Europe; English shoemakers were called 'cordwainers' after it. The story is premium craft that gets better with age. It has hard K and D sounds.
Cordovan.story_sr: Kordovan je gusta, izuzetno trajna koža nazvana po Kordobi, čiji su kožari bili čuveni u srednjovekovnoj Evropi; engleski obućari su po njoj nazvani 'cordwainers'. Priča je o vrhunskom zanatu koji s godinama postaje bolji.

Merestone.name: Merestone
Merestone.story: A merestone is a boundary stone that marks the edge of owned land (Old English 'mere' means boundary). The story is ownership: the company's own products marked out as its own ground.
Merestone.story_sr: Merestone je međaš, kamen koji obeležava granicu poseda (staroengleski 'mere' znači granica). Priča je o vlasništvu: sopstveni proizvodi kao sopstvena, omeđena zemlja.

Fusee.name: Fusee
Fusee.story: The fusee is the cone-shaped pulley in fine clocks and chronometers that evens out the pull of the mainspring. Thanks to it the timepiece keeps steady time from fully wound to nearly run down. The story is steady, even output, and the name ends in a -ze sound.
Fusee.story_sr: Fusee je kupasti kotur u finim satovima i hronometrima koji ujednačava silu glavne opruge, pa sat ide jednako tačno od punog navoja do kraja. Priča je o postojanom, ujednačenom rezultatu, a završava se zvukom -ze.

Belay.name: Belay
Belay.story: To belay is to make a rope fast around a pin or cleat in sailing, or to secure a climbing partner. The story is securing things and making them hold. It is short, two syllables.
Belay.story_sr: Belay znači učvrstiti konopac oko klina ili bitve u jedrenju, ili osigurati partnera pri penjanju. Priča je o sigurnosti i o tome da stvari drže, u kratkoj reči od dva sloga.

Kersey.name: Kersey
Kersey.story: Kersey is a coarse, hard-wearing woollen cloth named after the village of Kersey in Suffolk and exported across Europe from the Middle Ages. The story is a small place making a durable product for the world, like a Serbian team exporting software. It reads like a surname.
Kersey.story_sr: Kersey je gruba, izdržljiva vunena tkanina nazvana po selu Kersey u Safoku, izvožena širom Evrope od srednjeg veka. Priča je o malom mestu koje pravi trajan proizvod za ceo svet, kao srpski tim koji izvozi softver; zvuči kao prezime.

Brevier.name: Brevier
Brevier.story: Brevier is the old typefounders' name for 8-point type, so called because it was used to print breviaries. The story is typefounding heritage: small type doing serious work. It opens with the Br- sound the founder likes.
Brevier.story_sr: Brevier je stari livnički naziv za slovo veličine 8 tipografskih tačaka, nazvan tako jer se koristio za štampanje brevijara. Priča je o nasleđu livenja slova, o malim slovima koja rade ozbiljan posao, a počinje sa Br- koje osnivač voli.

Cotter.name: Cotter
Cotter.story: A cotter is the wedge or pin driven through a slot to lock machine parts together, like the cotter pin that keeps a wheel on its axle. The story is the small part that holds everything together. It reads like a surname.
Cotter.story_sr: Koter (cotter) je klin ili rascepka koja se provlači kroz otvor da zaključa delove mašine, kao rascepka koja drži točak na osovini. Priča je o malom delu koji sve drži na okupu, a zvuči kao prezime.

Winze.name: Winze
Winze.story: In mining, a winze is a shaft sunk from inside the mine to connect one level to a deeper one. The story is digging deeper from what you have already built. It sounds exactly like 'wins' and is one hard syllable ending in -ze like Braze.
Winze.story_sr: U rudarstvu winze je okno koje se kopa iznutra, iz postojećeg hodnika, da poveže jedan nivo sa dubljim. Priča je o kopanju dublje iz onoga što je već izgrađeno, a izgovara se isto kao 'wins' (pobede); jedan je tvrd slog sa -ze kao Braze.

Florin.name: Florin
Florin.story: The florin was the gold coin of Florence, first struck in 1252. Its unchanging weight and purity made it the trusted standard of European trade for centuries. The story is value that holds, and it sounds like a first name.
Florin.story_sr: Florin je zlatnik Firence, prvi put iskovan 1252. godine, čija je nepromenljiva težina i čistoća od njega napravila pouzdan standard evropske trgovine vekovima. Priča je o vrednosti koja traje, a zvuči kao lično ime.

Collet.name: Collet
Collet.story: A collet is the split collar that grips a tool or workpiece in a lathe. In watchmaking it is also the tiny collar that holds the hairspring to the balance. The story is a precise grip, and it sounds like the name Colette.
Collet.story_sr: Kolet je razrezana čaura koja steže alat ili radni komad na strugu, a u časovničarstvu sićušni prsten koji drži spiralnu oprugu na balansu. Priča je o preciznom stisku, a zvuči kao ime Colette.

Binnacle.name: Binnacle
Binnacle.story: The binnacle is the housing on a ship's deck that holds the compass in front of the helmsman. It is lit at night and shielded from the ship's own iron. The story is the case that keeps the direction true for every product.
Binnacle.story_sr: Binakl je kućište na palubi ispred kormilara u kome stoji kompas, osvetljeno noću i zaštićeno od uticaja brodskog gvožđa. Priča je o kućištu koje čuva pravi pravac za svaki proizvod.

Latigo.name: Latigo
Latigo.story: Latigo is the tough, oil-tanned leather strap that cinches a Western saddle to the horse, and also the leather named after it. The story is the strap that holds the whole rig in place. It has three open syllables that are easy to say worldwide.
Latigo.story_sr: Latigo je čvrst, uljem štavljen kožni kaiš kojim se kaubojsko sedlo priteže uz konja, a i koža nazvana po njemu. Priča je o kaišu koji drži celu opremu na mestu, u tri otvorena sloga koja se lako izgovaraju svuda.

Harmos.name: Harmos
Harmos.story: Greek 'joint, fastening peg': harmonia first meant the joinery that held a ship's planks together (Odysseus pegs his boat 'with harmoniai'), and only later music. It hides the same joining-craft story as Braze. Small software uses exist (harmos.io workflow tool, a Tokyo HR app); .studio and .dev are free.
Harmos.story_sr: Grčki 'spoj, klin': harmonia je prvo značila stolarski spoj dasaka na brodu (Odisej tako gradi splav), a tek kasnije muziku. Ista skrivena priča o spajanju kao kod Braze.

Tekmar.name: Tekmar
Tekmar.story: Homeric Greek for a fixed mark, a goal or a sure token. In the Iliad Zeus calls his nod the greatest tekmor, the pledge that will be kept. It has hard K and R like Braze; the non-software firms tekmar (heating controls) and Tekmar Group (offshore) already use it.
Tekmar.story_sr: Homerski grčki za čvrst znak, cilj ili siguran dokaz; Zevs u Ilijadi svoj naklon zove najvećim tekmorom, zalogom koji se ispunjava. Tvrdo K i R, zvuči kao ime.

Ferrumen.name: Ferrumen
Ferrumen.story: Latin 'solder, binding cement' (ferruminare = to solder, braze): the joint that makes two metals one. It is the closest Latin twin of Braze's hidden story. Almost every domain is free, and the only user found is a Guatemalan steel dealer.
Ferrumen.story_sr: Latinski 'lem, vezivo' (ferruminare = lemiti): spoj koji od dva metala pravi jedan. Najbliži latinski blizanac priče Braze, a skoro svi domeni su slobodni.

Amussis.name: Amussis
Amussis.story: Latin for the mason's and carpenter's rule; the idiom 'ad amussim' means 'exactly, done by the rule'. It is a rare word with a hidden story of precision; the only users found are a painting firm and a Hong Kong investigations firm, and .co/.studio/.app/.dev/.ai are free.
Amussis.story_sr: Latinski zidarski/stolarski lenjir; izraz 'ad amussim' znači 'tačno, urađeno po pravilu'. Retka reč sa skrivenom pričom o preciznosti.

Nexum.name: Nexum
Nexum.story: The oldest binding contract in Roman law, sealed with bronze and scales (per aes et libram): a bond that holds. It is a serious legal root with a hard x, for a company built on commitments that last.
Nexum.story_sr: Najstariji obavezujući ugovor rimskog prava, zaključivan uz bronzu i vagu (per aes et libram). Ozbiljan pravni koren sa tvrdim 'ks', za firmu koja drži reč.

Vectis.name: Vectis
Vectis.story: Latin 'lever', and the Roman name of the Isle of Wight; it recalls Archimedes' lever that lets a small force move the world. That suits a small team whose own products give outsized leverage, with a hard -ct- like Adacta.
Vectis.story_sr: Latinski 'poluga' (i rimsko ime ostrva Vajt); Arhimedova poluga kojom mala sila pomera svet. Mala firma čiji sopstveni proizvodi daju veliku polugu.

Cardo.name: Cardo
Cardo.story: Latin 'hinge, pivot', and the main north-south street from which every Roman town was laid out; it is the root of 'cardinal', the thing on which everything turns. As a holding name, it is the pivot its products turn on. Cardo Systems (motorcycle intercoms) already uses the name.
Cardo.story_sr: Latinski 'šarka, stožer' i glavna ulica sever-jug od koje se planirao svaki rimski grad; koren reči 'kardinalan'. Holding kao stožer oko kog se okreću proizvodi.

Zeugma.name: Zeugma
Zeugma.story: Greek 'a yoking, a joining', and the ancient city on the Euphrates named for the bridge of boats that joined its two banks. It joins client work and own products, and the Z gives it the -ze energy of Braze.
Zeugma.story_sr: Grčki 'sprezanje, spoj', i antički grad na Eufratu nazvan po mostu od čamaca koji je spajao dve obale. Spaja klijentski rad i sopstvene proizvode.

Pinax.name: Pinax
Pinax.story: Greek 'tablet, register'. Callimachus's Pinakes at the Library of Alexandria was the first library catalogue in history, a quiet nod to Quicktalog. The name ends on a hard x; note that Pinax is also an old open-source Django project.
Pinax.story_sr: Grčki 'tablica, registar'; Kalimahove Pinakes u Aleksandrijskoj biblioteci bile su prvi katalog u istoriji, što je tiha veza sa Quicktalogom.

Koinon.name: Koinon
Koinon.story: Greek 'the common thing': a koinon was a league of independent city-states under one shared name. That is exactly a holding whose products keep their own brands, and it can later become the umbrella.
Koinon.story_sr: Grčki 'zajedničko': koinon je bio savez nezavisnih gradova-država pod jednim zajedničkim imenom, baš kao holding čiji proizvodi zadržavaju svoja imena.

Textor.name: Textor
Textor.story: Latin 'weaver', from texere, which gave us text, texture and context (and, through the old root teks-, even technique). It names a maker who weaves text and systems and reads like a surname; the football investor John Textor is a well-known bearer.
Textor.story_sr: Latinski 'tkač', od texere, odakle su tekst, tekstura i kontekst (a preko korena teks- i tehnika). Tvorac koji tka tekst i sisteme; zvuči kao prezime.

Cadmus.name: Cadmus
Cadmus.story: The Greek hero who brought the alphabet ('Cadmean letters') to Greece and founded Thebes, so the name joins founding and writing. It sounds like a person's name, with a hard C-d; the Cadmus Group, a US consultancy, already uses it.
Cadmus.story_sr: Grčki junak koji je doneo alfabet Grcima ('kadmejska slova') i osnovao Tebu: osnivač i pismo. Zvuči kao ime osobe.

Meruit.name: Meruit
Meruit.story: Latin 'he has earned', from the legal doctrine quantum meruit ('as much as he has earned'): fair pay for work actually done. It stands for earned value rather than hype, and .io/.studio/.app/.dev are free.
Meruit.story_sr: Latinski 'zaslužio je', iz pravne doktrine quantum meruit ('koliko je zaslužio'): pravična naknada za stvarno obavljen rad. Zarađena vrednost, bez hajpa.

Junctura.name: Junctura
Junctura.story: Latin 'joint, joining'. Horace's 'callida iunctura' is the clever joining that makes ordinary words new, the same joining story as Braze, carried into making things.
Junctura.story_sr: Latinski 'spoj'; Horacijeva 'callida iunctura' je vešto spajanje koje obične reči čini novim. Ista priča o spajanju kao kod Braze.

Dioptra.name: Dioptra
Dioptra.story: The Greek surveying instrument described by Hero of Alexandria and used to lay out aqueducts and tunnels; the name means 'the thing you see through'. It is an engineer's tool for planning large works, with hard D, pt and tr sounds.
Dioptra.story_sr: Grčki geodetski instrument (Heron Aleksandrijski) za trasiranje akvadukta i tunela, 'ono kroz šta se gleda'. Inženjerski alat za planiranje velikih dela.

Artifex.name: Artifex
Artifex.story: Latin 'master craftsman, maker' (ars + facere). It is a proud maker name that works as 'Quicktalog by Artifex', but the existing company Artifex Software (Ghostscript, MuPDF) raises the trademark risk.
Artifex.story_sr: Latinski 'majstor, tvorac' (ars + facere); ponosno majstorsko ime koje radi kao 'Quicktalog by Artifex'. Postoji Artifex Software, pa je rizik od žiga veći.

Tessera.name: Tessera
Tessera.story: Latin and Greek 'tile, token'. The tessera hospitalis was a token that a host and a guest broke in two as proof of a lasting bond, and tesserae are the tiles of a mosaic, like a holding of many small products that form one picture. Tessera (now Xperi) and Consensys Tessera already use the name.
Tessera.story_sr: 'Pločica, žeton': tessera hospitalis je žeton koji su domaćin i gost prelomili kao dokaz trajnog saveza, a tesere su kamenčići mozaika. Holding od mnogo proizvoda koji čine jednu sliku.

Clavis.name: Clavis
Clavis.story: Latin 'key'. A clavis was also the key to a cipher, or a reference work that unlocks a text. The name is short, hard and serious: a holding that keeps the keys to its products.
Clavis.story_sr: Latinski 'ključ'; clavis je bio i ključ šifre ili priručnik koji otključava tekst. Holding koji drži ključeve svojih proizvoda.

Vindex.name: Vindex
Vindex.story: Latin 'guarantor, champion': in early Roman procedure the vindex stepped in and personally answered for another party. It suits a company that stands behind what it ships, with hard V, nd and x sounds.
Vindex.story_sr: Latinski 'jemac, zaštitnik': u ranom rimskom postupku vindex je stupao umesto druge strane i lično odgovarao. Firma koja stoji iza onoga što isporuči.

Exnovo.name: Exnovo
Exnovo.story: Latin 'ex novo', meaning 'anew, from the ground up'; law and architecture use it for things built fresh rather than adapted. It is contracted the same way as Adacta and fits a company that builds its own products from scratch. Only .studio is free.
Exnovo.story_sr: Latinski 'ex novo', 'iznova, od temelja': ono što je izgrađeno novo, a ne prepravljeno. Spojeno kao Adacta; firma koja proizvode gradi od nule.

Capsa.name: Capsa
Capsa.story: The Latin cylindrical box for carrying scrolls, and the root of case, capsule and (through the French caisse) cash. It holds the works safely and has a hard C-ps; Capsa Healthcare (US) already uses the name.
Capsa.story_sr: Latinska cilindrična kutija za nošenje svitaka; koren reči case, kapsula i (preko francuskog caisse) cash. Čuva dela.

Mensor.name: Mensor
Mensor.story: Latin 'measurer': the Roman mensor surveyed and marked out land, camps and cities before anything was built. It means 'measure, then build' and sounds serious; Mensor, a WIKA brand of pressure instruments, already uses it.
Mensor.story_sr: Latinski 'merač': rimski mensor je premeravao zemlju, logore i gradove pre gradnje. Izmeri, pa gradi; ozbiljan zvuk.

Solon.name: Solon
Solon.story: The Athenian lawgiver who wrote fair rules and then left so they would work without him; in English 'a solon' is a wise legislator. It is name-like with calm authority; the former German solar firm SOLON used it.
Solon.story_sr: Atinski zakonodavac koji je napisao pravična pravila i otišao da bi radila bez njega; na engleskom 'a solon' je mudar zakonodavac. Zvuči kao ime.

Ductus.name: Ductus
Ductus.story: Latin 'leading, conduct'. In calligraphy the ductus is the order, direction and speed of the strokes that build a letter: the method behind the mark. It suits a company that cares how things are built, with a hard -ct-.
Ductus.story_sr: Latinski 'vođenje'; u kaligrafiji ductus je redosled, smer i brzina poteza kojima se gradi slovo, tj. metod iza znaka.

Sator.name: Sator
Sator.story: Latin 'sower, founder, creator', and the first word of the SATOR AREPO TENET OPERA ROTAS square found at Pompeii, which reads the same in four directions. It carries a founder story plus a hidden puzzle; Nolan's film Tenet named its villain Sator.
Sator.story_sr: Latinski 'sejač, osnivač, tvorac', i prva reč kvadrata SATOR AREPO TENET OPERA ROTAS iz Pompeja koji se čita isto u četiri smera.

Atticus.name: Atticus
Atticus.story: Titus Pomponius Atticus, Cicero's friend, ran a famed book-copying and publishing workshop in Rome and was known for integrity; the name also recalls Atticus Finch. It reads as the name of a person you can trust, though law firms and funds use it often.
Atticus.story_sr: Tit Pomponije Atik, Ciceronov prijatelj, vodio je čuvenu izdavačku radionicu u Rimu i bio poznat po čestitosti. Zvuči kao ime osobe od poverenja.

Periplus.name: Periplus
Periplus.story: Greek 'sailing around': a merchant captain's written guide to ports, distances and goods, as in the Periplus of the Erythraean Sea. It is a practical manual for global trade, fitting a company that sells to US, EU and global users; .io and .studio are free.
Periplus.story_sr: Grčki 'plovidba okolo': pisani vodič trgovačkog kapetana sa lukama, razdaljinama i robom. Priručnik globalne trgovine.

Dubsar.name: Dubsar
Dubsar.story: Sumerian 'tablet-writer', the scribe of the first cities and the oldest professional knowledge worker. It is an old root beyond Latin and Greek, with a hard D-b, and it sounds like a name; .studio and .dev are free.
Dubsar.story_sr: Sumerski 'pisar tablica', pisar prvih gradova i najstariji profesionalni radnik znanja. Tvrdo D-b, zvuči kao ime.

Bewick.name: Bewick
Bewick.story: Thomas Bewick (1753-1828) was a Newcastle wood engraver who perfected end-grain engraving, so fine pictures could be printed cheaply next to text. Bewick's swan is named after him. TMview shows 6 marks, none in software classes, and every domain except .com is free.
Bewick.story_sr: Thomas Bewick (1753-1828), gravera iz Njukasla, usavršio je graviranje na poprečnom preseku drveta, pa su se fine ilustracije štampale jeftino uz tekst; po njemu je nazvan Bjuikov labud. TMview: 6 oznaka, nijedna u softverskim klasama.

Pynson.name: Pynson

Outram.name: Outram

He built early plateways (iron rail tracks) and co-founded the Butterley ironworks, and a popular legend says the word 'tram' comes from his name. It is a strong two-syllable surname.
