Bernward.name: Bernward
Bernward.story: Saint Bernward of Hildesheim (c.960-1022) was a bishop and master metalworker who made the bronze Bernward Doors. He is the patron saint of goldsmiths, sculptors and architects. The name sounds like a strong Germanic first name and starts with Br-. TMview shows one expired local mark, and 6 of 7 domains are free.
Bernward.story_sr: Sveti Bernvard iz Hildeshajma (oko 960-1022), biskup i majstor obrade metala, tvorac bronzanih Bernvardovih vrata, zaštitnik je zlatara, vajara i arhitekata. Zvuči kao snažno germansko ime; TMview pokazuje samo jednu isteklu lokalnu oznaku.

Lanston.name: Lanston
Lanston.story: Tolbert Lanston (1844-1913) invented the Monotype machine. A keyboard punched a paper ribbon, and the ribbon then drove the type caster: data first, output second, much like software. The spelling is plain English and passes the radio test. TMview shows only clothing marks.
Lanston.story_sr: Tolbert Lanston (1844-1913) izumeo je Monotype mašinu: tastatura buši papirnu traku koja zatim upravlja livenjem slova, prvo podaci pa rezultat, kao softver. Pravopis je jednostavan engleski; TMview: samo oznake za odeću.

Gofannon.name: Gofannon
Gofannon.story: Gofannon, son of Don, is the divine smith of Welsh myth (Welsh 'gof' means smith) and the counterpart of the Irish Goibniu. In Culhwch and Olwen he is the one smith who can make the plough irons. A mythic maker whose name sounds like a surname. TMview shows only two lapsed marks.
Gofannon.story_sr: Gofanon, sin boginje Don, božanski je kovač velške mitologije (velški 'gof' znači kovač), pandan irskom Gobnuu; u priči o Kilhuhu i Olven samo on može da iskuje gvožđe za plug. TMview: samo dve ugašene oznake.

Moretus.name: Moretus
Moretus.story: Jan Moretus (1543-1610), Plantin's son-in-law, took over the Golden Compasses press in Antwerp. His family ran it for three centuries, and the workshop is now the UNESCO-listed Plantin-Moretus Museum. It sounds Latin and serious, like Adacta. TMview shows only museum compounds.
Moretus.story_sr: Jan Moretus (1543-1610), Plantenov zet, preuzeo je štampariju 'Zlatni šestar' u Antverpenu; porodica ju je vodila tri veka, a danas je to muzej Plantin-Moretus pod zaštitom UNESKO-a. Latinski zvuk, ozbiljan kao Adacta.

Ramelli.name: Ramelli
Ramelli.story: Agostino Ramelli (1531-c.1610) was an Italian engineer. His 1588 book of machines introduced the 'book wheel', a rotating reading desk often called the first hypertext machine, which suits catalogue software like Quicktalog. TMview shows nothing in software classes, and every domain except .com is free.
Ramelli.story_sr: Agostino Ramelli (1531-oko 1610), italijanski inženjer, u knjizi mašina iz 1588. predstavio je 'točak za knjige', rotirajući pult koji se naziva prvom hipertekst mašinom, što pristaje softveru za kataloge kao što je Quicktalog. TMview: ništa u softverskim klasama.

Digges.name: Digges
Digges.story: Leonard Digges (c.1515-1559) was an English surveyor credited with inventing the theodolite, the angle-measuring instrument that made precise mapping possible. His son Thomas continued the work. The name is short and hard. TMview shows nothing relevant in software classes.
Digges.story_sr: Leonard Digges (oko 1515-1559), engleski geometar, smatra se pronalazačem teodolita, instrumenta za merenje uglova koji je omogućio precizno kartiranje; posao je nastavio sin Thomas. TMview: ništa relevantno u softverskim klasama.

Behaim.name: Behaim
Behaim.story: Martin Behaim (1459-1507), a Nuremberg cosmographer, made the Erdapfel (1492), the oldest surviving globe. It modelled the whole world before anyone had seen it. TMview shows only a few marks, and every domain except .com is free.
Behaim.story_sr: Martin Behaim (1459-1507), nirnberški kosmograf, napravio je Erdapfel (1492), najstariji sačuvani globus, model celog sveta pre nego što ga je iko video. TMview: svega nekoliko oznaka.

Maskelyne.name: Maskelyne
Maskelyne.story: Nevil Maskelyne (1732-1811), Astronomer Royal, founded the Nautical Almanac. He ran it with a network of human 'computers' who worked from home and sent their calculations by post, an early distributed remote team. TMview shows one hotel-bar mark only, and every domain except .com is free.
Maskelyne.story_sr: Nevil Maskelyne (1732-1811), kraljevski astronom, pokrenuo je Nautički almanah i vodio mrežu ljudskih 'računara' koji su radili od kuće i slali proračune poštom, rani udaljeni tim. TMview: samo jedna oznaka za hotelski bar.

Baudot.name: Baudot
Baudot.story: Emile Baudot (1845-1903) was a French telegraph engineer. His 5-bit Baudot code is the ancestor of digital text encoding, and the unit 'baud' is named after him. TMview shows only 8 compound or lapsed marks, but only .studio and .app are free.
Baudot.story_sr: Emil Bodo (1845-1903), francuski telegrafski inženjer, tvorac je petobitnog koda koji je predak digitalnog zapisa teksta; po njemu je nazvana jedinica 'bod' (baud). TMview: samo 8 složenih ili ugašenih oznaka.

Burgi.name: Burgi
Burgi.story: Jost Burgi (1552-1632) was clockmaker to Emperor Rudolf II. His clocks were the most accurate of their day and among the first with a seconds hand, and he discovered logarithms independently of Napier. The name has five letters and a Br-like sound. TMview marks are for watches only (class 14).
Burgi.story_sr: Jost Birgi (1552-1632), časovničar cara Rudolfa II, pravio je najtačnije satove svog vremena, među prvima sa sekundarom, i nezavisno od Napijera otkrio logaritme. TMview: oznake samo za satove (klasa 14).

Bodmer.name: Bodmer
Bodmer.story: Johann Georg Bodmer (1786-1864) was a Swiss inventor-engineer in Manchester. He patented improvements to machine tools, gear cutting and textile machines, a quiet and precise maker. TMview shows only compound marks: a Swiss bank and the Bodmer Library foundation.
Bodmer.story_sr: Johan Georg Bodmer (1786-1864), švajcarski pronalazač i inženjer u Mančesteru, patentirao je poboljšanja alatnih mašina, rezanja zupčanika i tekstilnih mašina. TMview: samo složene oznake (švajcarska banka, Fondacija Bodmer).

Koberger.name: Koberger
Koberger.story: Anton Koberger (c.1440-1513) ran 24 presses with about 100 workers in Nuremberg and printed the Nuremberg Chronicle, the first publishing house at industrial scale. He was also Durer's godfather. TMview shows a US class 9 mark (Jie Xu) to check before filing.
Koberger.story_sr: Anton Koberger (oko 1440-1513) vodio je u Nirnbergu 24 prese sa stotinak radnika i štampao Nirnberšku hroniku, prva izdavačka kuća industrijskih razmera; bio je i kum Albrehta Direra. TMview: američka oznaka u klasi 9 koju treba proveriti.

Gryphius.name: Gryphius
Gryphius.story: Sebastian Gryphius (c.1492-1556) was a German-born printer in Lyon. His griffin device and motto 'Virtute duce, comite fortuna' marked some of the finest books of the century. The name opens with a hard Gr- and carries a mythic griffin. TMview shows one US class 9 mark (Markanna Studios).
Gryphius.story_sr: Sebastijan Grifijus (oko 1492-1556), štampar nemačkog porekla u Lionu, obeležavao je znakom grifona i motom 'Virtute duce, comite fortuna' neke od najlepših knjiga veka. TMview: jedna američka oznaka u klasi 9.

Ellicott.name: Ellicott
Ellicott.story: Two makers share this name. John Ellicott (1706-1772) was a London clockmaker (FRS) who built the compensated pendulum. Andrew Ellicott (1754-1820) was the surveyor who laid out Washington, D.C. The name resonates in the US. TMview marks are for dredging machinery and watches.
Ellicott.story_sr: Dva majstora u jednom imenu: John Ellicott (1706-1772), londonski časovničar i tvorac kompenzovanog klatna, i Andrew Ellicott (1754-1820), geometar koji je iscrtao Vašington. TMview: oznake za bagere i satove.

Corliss.name: Corliss
Corliss.story: George Corliss (1817-1888) was an American engineer. His steam engine, with its precise valve gear, powered the whole 1876 Centennial Exhibition in Philadelphia. The name is firm and person-like. TMview shows an EU class 9 mark for bags and phone cases, and only .studio is free.
Corliss.story_sr: Džordž Korlis (1817-1888), američki inženjer, napravio je parnu mašinu sa preciznim ventilima koja je pokretala celu izložbu stogodišnjice 1876. u Filadelfiji. TMview: EU oznaka u klasi 9 (torbe); slobodan samo .studio.

Whitworth.name: Whitworth
Whitworth.story: Sir Joseph Whitworth (1803-1887) created the first national screw-thread standard (1841) and a measuring machine accurate to a millionth of an inch: standards and precision. TMview marks are mostly Whitworth University, but only .studio is free.
Whitworth.story_sr: Ser Džozef Vitvort (1803-1887) stvorio je prvi nacionalni standard navoja (1841) i mašinu za merenje tačnu na milioniti deo inča: standardi i preciznost. TMview: uglavnom oznake univerziteta; slobodan samo .studio.

Orfelin.name: Orfelin
Orfelin.story: Zaharije Orfelin (1726-1785) was a Serbian polymath: engraver, calligrapher, poet, and publisher of the first Serbian magazine (Venice, 1768). A local maker story told globally, like Koshava. TMview shows a Serbian class 35 mark (Optimed) to clear.
Orfelin.story_sr: Zaharije Orfelin (1726-1785), srpski polihistor, bio je bakrorezac, kaligraf, pesnik i izdavač prvog srpskog časopisa (Venecija, 1768), lokalna priča ispričana svetu, kao Košava. TMview: srpska oznaka u klasi 35 (Optimed) koju treba proveriti.

Stanhope.name: Stanhope
Stanhope.story: Charles, 3rd Earl Stanhope (1753-1816), built the first all-iron printing press and the Stanhope Demonstrator, the first machine to solve logic problems: printing plus early computing. TMview shows a German class 9/42 mark and Stanhope Capital (class 36), so there is some risk.
Stanhope.story_sr: Čarls, treći erl Stanhoup (1753-1816), napravio je prvu potpuno gvozdenu štamparsku presu i Stanhoupov demonstrator, prvu mašinu koja rešava logičke zadatke: štampa plus rano računarstvo. TMview: nemačka oznaka u klasama 9/42, određen rizik.

Gesner.name: Gesner
Gesner.story: Conrad Gessner (1516-1565) published the Bibliotheca universalis (1545), the first universal catalogue of books, and is called the 'father of bibliography'. That is a direct nod to Quicktalog. TMview shows a Spanish class 42 mark.
Gesner.story_sr: Konrad Gesner (1516-1565) objavio je Bibliotheca universalis (1545), prvi univerzalni katalog knjiga, pa ga zovu 'ocem bibliografije', što je direktna veza sa Quicktalogom. TMview: španska oznaka u klasi 42.

Senex.name: Senex
Senex.story: John Senex (1678-1740) was a London engraver, mapmaker and globe maker (FRS). His name is Latin for 'elder', the root of senior and senate, and ends in a hard x. TMview is crowded, including a Chinese class 9 mark and a US class 35 mark.
Senex.story_sr: John Senex (1678-1740), londonski gravera, kartograf i izrađivač globusa; ime na latinskom znači 'starešina', koren reči senior i senat. TMview: dosta oznaka, uključujući kinesku u klasi 9 i američku u klasi 35.

Borda.name: Borda
Borda.story: Jean-Charles de Borda (1733-1799) was a French engineer. His repeating circle measured the meridian that defined the metre, and the Borda count voting method is also his. The name is short and hard. TMview flags Borda Teknoloji (Turkey, classes 9/42).
Borda.story_sr: Žan-Šarl de Borda (1733-1799), francuski inženjer, napravio je ponavljajući krug kojim je izmeren meridijan za definiciju metra; njegov je i Bordin metod glasanja. TMview: Borda Teknoloji (Turska, klase 9/42).

Granjon.name: Granjon
Granjon.story: Robert Granjon (1513-1590) was a French punchcutter. He created the Civilite type and cut the first Arabic types for the Medici Press in Rome, letterforms carried across cultures. TMview shows a Monotype US class 9 font mark, though every domain except .com is free.
Granjon.story_sr: Rober Granžon (1513-1590), francuski rezač slova, stvorio je pismo Civilité i prva arapska slova za štampariju Medičijevih u Rimu. TMview: Monotype oznaka za font u SAD (klasa 9), mada su slobodni svi domeni osim .com.

Fairbairn.name: Fairbairn
Fairbairn.story: Sir William Fairbairn (1789-1874) was a Scottish engineer in Manchester. He built iron ships, invented a riveting machine and designed the tubular Britannia Bridge with Stephenson. In Scots the name reads 'fair child'. TMview marks are unrelated (an airport, knives), and .studio and .ai are free.
Fairbairn.story_sr: Ser Vilijam Ferbern (1789-1874), škotski inženjer u Mančesteru, gradio je gvozdene brodove, izumeo mašinu za zakivanje i sa Stivensonom projektovao cevasti most Britanija; na škotskom ime znači 'lepo dete'. TMview: nevezane oznake.

Didot.name: Didot
Didot.story: The Didots of Paris were printers, typefounders and papermakers. Francois-Ambroise Didot set the typographic point that Europe still uses, and the first continuous paper machine was built at a Didot mill. TMview shows font associations and a Czech class 42 mark, and only .dev is free.
Didot.story_sr: Porodica Dido iz Pariza bili su štampari, livci slova i proizvođači papira: François-Ambroise Didot uveo je tipografski punkt koji se u Evropi i danas koristi, a u njihovoj fabrici nastala je prva mašina za kontinualni papir. TMview: veza sa fontovima i češka oznaka u klasi 42.

pending_verify.name: Ramelli
pending_verify.tm_note: TMview contains-search returns 163 hits, most of them CARAMELLI, SCARAMELLI or GRAMELLINI food marks. The only live identical RAMELLI mark is at TURKPATENT (class 25, footwear and clothing). There is no live identical or near-identical mark in class 9, 35 or 42 at USPTO, EUIPO, WIPO or Serbia. 'ramellia' is filed in Turkey (classes 14, 25, 35), which is outside the offices checked.
pending_verify.conflict_note: No software, tech, AI or agency brand uses the name. The name is closely linked to Serge Ramelli, a well-known French-American photographer and Lightroom/Photoshop educator who sells presets and courses under his full name. Others are Ramelli Janitorial Service Inc (Louisiana) and scattered people with the surname. ramelli.com is taken.
pending_verify.language_note: Italian surname with no meaning in English, Spanish, French, Italian or Hungarian. In Serbian 'rame' means shoulder, which is neutral. In German there is a faint echo of the vulgar colloquial 'rammeln', but the stress differs (ra-MEL-li vs RAM-meln), so the risk is low. It reads Italian rather than Latin or hard-consonant, so it is softer than the Braze/Brame anchors.

pending_verify.name: Bodmer
pending_verify.tm_note: TMview shows 21 hits and no live identical mark in class 9, 35 or 42 at USPTO, EUIPO, WIPO or Serbia. Identical BODMER marks exist only in Korea (classes 11 and 35, filed) and Mexico (36). Watch-outs: in Switzerland (IGE, outside the offices checked), Fondation Martin Bodmer holds 'BODMER LAB' in classes 9/16/35/37/41/42, and Rahn+Bodmer Co. (private bank) holds marks in 35/36/42. This matters if the company later wants to be 'Bodmer Labs'.
pending_verify.conflict_note: No established software, tech or agency company uses the name. The closest same-name uses are 'Bodmer Studio', a small Instagram account with about 230 followers, and Simone Bodmer-Turner Studio (a New York sculptor and designer). Nick Bodmer is an indie iOS developer who publishes apps under his own name. Outside tech, the name belongs to Rahn+Bodmer (a Zurich private bank since 1750), the Fondation Martin Bodmer / Bibliotheca Bodmeriana and the painter Karl Bodmer. bodmer.com, .io and .co are all taken.
pending_verify.language_note: Swiss-German surname with no negative meaning. In English 'bod' is harmless slang for body. The archaic German 'Bodmerei' (bottomry loan) is neutral. In Serbian 'bod' means point or stitch, which is neutral. Spanish 'boda' (wedding) is not close enough to matter. Nothing in French, Italian or Hungarian. It is short and hard (B-d-m), close to the Br-/-ct sound profile.

Ferrund.name: Ferrund
Ferrund.story: Coined from Latin ferrum (iron) and fundere (to pour or cast), which is the root of both 'foundry' and 'to found' a company. So it means an iron foundry that also founds things. All 7 domains are free, including .com, and the web shows only a rare French surname.
Ferrund.story_sr: Skovano od latinskog ferrum (gvožđe) i fundere (liti), korena reči 'livnica' i engleskog 'found' (osnovati): livnica gvožđa koja i osniva. Svih 7 domena je slobodno, uključujući .com.

Valifex.name: Valifex
Valifex.story: Latin valor (worth) plus -fex (maker), the ending of artifex (master craftsman), opifex and pontifex. It means 'the maker of value', which suits a company that builds and owns what it sells. All 7 domains are free, including .com, and it turns up only as online usernames.
Valifex.story_sr: Latinsko valor (vrednost) i -fex (tvorac), nastavak iz reči artifex (majstor), opifex i pontifex: 'tvorac vrednosti' za firmu koja pravi i poseduje ono što prodaje. Svih 7 domena je slobodno, uključujući .com.

Argund.name: Argund
Argund.story: Latin argentum (silver) plus fund- from fundere (to cast): 'the silver-caster'. It is hard, has two syllables and reads like an old Nordic first name. All 7 domains are free, including .com, and it exists only as a rare surname.
Argund.story_sr: Latinsko argentum (srebro) i fund- od fundere (liti): 'livac srebra'. Zvuči kao staro nordijsko ime, a svih 7 domena je slobodno, uključujući .com.

Fabrund.name: Fabrund
Fabrund.story: Latin faber (smith, maker; the root of fabric and fabricate) plus fund- from fundere (to cast or found): 'the maker's foundry'. All 7 domains are free, including .com, and no business uses the name.
Fabrund.story_sr: Latinsko faber (kovač, majstor; koren reči fabrika) i fund- od fundere (liti, osnovati): 'majstorova livnica'. Svih 7 domena je slobodno, uključujući .com.

Anfelt.name: Anfelt
Anfelt.story: Old Saxon anfelt and Old English anfilt both mean 'anvil', literally 'the thing struck upon'. It reads like a Scandinavian surname and hides a forge story inside a quiet holding name. .com is taken; the other 6 domains are free.
Anfelt.story_sr: Staro-saksonsko anfelt i staroenglesko anfilt znače 'nakovanj', doslovno 'ono po čemu se udara'. Zvuči kao skandinavsko prezime; .com je zauzet, ostalih 6 slobodno.

Domifex.name: Domifex
Domifex.story: Latin domi (at home) plus -fex (maker): 'the one who makes at home', which fits a company whose revenue comes mostly from its own products. Biologists already use it for a wolf spider that builds its own burrow 'castle' (Geolycosa domifex). No company uses it; .com is taken.
Domifex.story_sr: Latinsko domi (kod kuće) i -fex (tvorac): 'onaj koji pravi kod kuće', za firmu koja živi od sopstvenih proizvoda. Isto ime nosi vuk-pauk koji sam gradi svoju 'kulu' (Geolycosa domifex).

Dextan.name: Dextan
Dextan.story: Latin dexter (the skilled right hand; the root of dexterity) plus -an, so it reads like a real given name. The idea is skill of hand. .com is taken; the other 6 domains are free and no company uses the name.
Dextan.story_sr: Latinsko dexter (vešta desna ruka, koren reči 'spretnost') i nastavak -an, pa zvuči kao pravo ime. .com je zauzet, ostalih 6 slobodno, bez firmi pod tim imenom.

Amussen.name: Amussen
Amussen.story: Latin amussis was the Roman builder's straightedge, and 'ad amussim' means 'exactly, true to the rule', the same 'ad' idiom as Adacta. The Nordic -sen ending makes it sound like a surname (a rare Danish one). .com is taken; the other 6 domains are free.
Amussen.story_sr: Latinsko amussis je rimski graditeljski lenjir, a 'ad amussim' znači 'tačno, po meri', isti 'ad' izraz kao Adacta. Sa nastavkom -sen zvuči kao prezime; .com je zauzet, ostalih 6 slobodno.

Stannor.name: Stannor
Stannor.story: Latin stannum (tin), the metal that turns copper into bronze and is the basis of solder. That gives it Braze's joining-metals story without sounding like Braze. .com is taken; a ceiling-fan model uses the name.
Stannor.story_sr: Latinsko stannum (kalaj), metal koji od bakra pravi bronzu i osnova je lema: ista priča o spajanju metala kao Braze, a ne liči na nju. .com je zauzet; ime nosi i jedan model plafonskog ventilatora.

Obriza.name: Obriza
Obriza.story: Latin aurum obrizum was gold refined and proven in fire, the standard of true value; obriza is the Latin adjective form. It has the Br- and -za sounds the founder likes. .com is taken; the other 6 domains are free.
Obriza.story_sr: Latinsko aurum obrizum je zlato prečišćeno i provereno u vatri, merilo prave vrednosti; obriza je latinski pridevski oblik. Ima Br- i -za zvuk; .com je zauzet, ostalih 6 slobodno.

Excuda.name: Excuda
Excuda.story: From Latin excudere (to hammer out, to forge), as in Virgil's Aeneid 6.847: 'excudent alii spirantia mollius aera' ('others will forge breathing bronze more gently'). .com is taken. It is one letter away from the Spanish word excusa ('excuse').
Excuda.story_sr: Od latinskog excudere (iskovati), kao kod Vergilija: 'excudent alii spirantia mollius aera' ('drugi će nežnije iskovati bronzu koja diše'). .com je zauzet; jedno slovo od španskog excusa ('izgovor').

Ambakt.name: Ambakt
Ambakt.story: Gaulish ambaktos ('one who serves') became Latin ambactus, Dutch ambacht ('craft, trade') and English ambassador, so one root covers both craft and client service. It has the hard -kt- ending. .com is taken; a UK AV-furniture brand uses the name.
Ambakt.story_sr: Galsko ambaktos ('onaj koji služi') dalo je latinsko ambactus, holandsko ambacht ('zanat') i englesko ambassador: zanat i služenje klijentu u jednom korenu. .com je zauzet; ime koristi britanski brend nameštaja.

Forgan.name: Forgan
Forgan.story: English forge plus -an, built like Morgan, so it sounds like a person's name. It is also a rare Scottish place name and surname. .com is taken; Forgan of St Andrews has made golf clubs since 1860.
Forgan.story_sr: Englesko forge (kovati, kovačnica) i nastavak -an po uzoru na Morgan, pa zvuči kao ime. .com je zauzet; postoji škotski proizvođač palica za golf Forgan (od 1860).

Malleon.name: Malleon
Malleon.story: Latin malleus (hammer), the root of 'malleable': the hammer that shapes metal, with the weight of an old name. .com and .io are taken. The name also belongs to a Game of Thrones maester and a small GitHub tool.
Malleon.story_sr: Latinsko malleus (čekić), koren reči 'malleable' (kovan, savitljiv): čekić koji oblikuje metal. .com i .io su zauzeti; ime se javlja u Igri prestola i kao mali GitHub alat.

Fervan.name: Fervan
Fervan.story: Latin fervere (to glow, to boil) describes the white heat of metal in the forge and is the root of fervent and ferment. The -an ending makes it read like a name. .com is taken; the other 6 domains are free, and a school in Bogota uses the name.
Fervan.story_sr: Latinsko fervere (usijati se, ključati), usijanje metala u vatri i koren reči 'fervor'. .com je zauzet, ostalih 6 slobodno.

Ergan.name: Ergan
Ergan.story: Greek ergon (work, deed; the root of energy, ergonomics and organ) plus -an: a short two-syllable name for 'the work itself'. .com is taken and the other 6 domains are free. It exists only as a surname, but it is close to the already-used 'ergana'.
Ergan.story_sr: Grčko ergon (delo, rad; koren reči energija i ergonomija) i nastavak -an: kratko ime za 'samo delo'. .com je zauzet, ostalih 6 slobodno.

Kaminor.name: Kaminor
Kaminor.story: Latin caminus (the smith's forge-hearth), which also gave Serbian kamin (fireplace), plus -or. It tells a Latin story and a local one at once. .com is taken; a Hungarian chimney firm and a pull-up-bar brand use the name.
Kaminor.story_sr: Latinsko caminus (kovačko ognjište), od koga je i naša reč kamin, i nastavak -or: latinska i domaća priča u jednoj reči. .com je zauzet; koriste ga mađarska firma za dimnjake i brend šipki za zgibove.

Limator.name: Limator
Limator.story: Latin limare (to file, to polish) comes from Horace's 'limae labor et mora', the toil and patience of the file, meaning the careful finishing of a work. .com is taken; Lindner uses the name for a shredder model.
Limator.story_sr: Latinsko limare (turpijati, glačati), iz Horacijevog 'limae labor et mora' (trud i strpljenje turpije), što znači brižljivo doterivanje dela. .com je zauzet; Lindner ima mašinu tog imena.

Querca.name: Querca
Querca.story: Latin quercus (oak) was the timber of shipwrights and roof beams and stands for strength that lasts. The name is short and hard. .com and .ai are taken; a UK medical-writing firm is called Querca Too.
Querca.story_sr: Latinsko quercus (hrast), drvo brodograditelja i krovnih greda, simbol trajne snage. .com i .ai su zauzeti; postoji britanska firma Querca Too.

Fraxen.name: Fraxen
Fraxen.story: Latin fraxinus (ash) was the wood of tool handles and spear shafts. The Nordic -sen ending makes it read like a surname and gives a hard Fr-/-x- sound. .com is taken; Fraxen is also the name of a Romanian fractional-executive consultancy.
Fraxen.story_sr: Latinsko fraxinus (jasen), drvo za drške alata i koplja, sa nordijskim nastavkom -sen, pa zvuči kao prezime. .com je zauzet; postoji rumunska konsultantska firma Fraxen.

Afabra.name: Afabra
Afabra.story: From Latin affabre ('skilfully, in a workmanlike way', from ad + faber), the same 'ad-' construction as Adacta (ad acta). .com is taken and the other 6 domains are free; a small firm in Lyon uses the name.
Afabra.story_sr: Od latinskog affabre ('majstorski, vešto', ad + faber), ista 'ad-' konstrukcija kao Adacta. .com je zauzet, ostalih 6 slobodno.

Orikal.name: Orikal
Orikal.story: From Greek oreikhalkos (orichalcum, 'mountain copper'), the gleaming legendary metal of Atlantis in Plato. .com and .ai are taken; a minor Marvel character is named Orikal.
Orikal.story_sr: Od grčkog oreikhalkos (orihalkum, 'planinski bakar'), legendarni sjajni metal Atlantide kod Platona. .com i .ai su zauzeti; postoji i sporedni Marvelov lik tog imena.

Kilnor.name: Kilnor
Kilnor.story: English kiln (from Latin culina) plus -or: the kiln fires clay into brick and porcelain that last. .com, .app, .dev and .ai are taken, and the name belongs to a boss in the game Absolver.

Fornel.name: Fornel

Condra.name: Condra

Tornel.name: Tornel

Arkiton.story_sr: Od grčkog arhitekton (glavni graditelj: arhi- 'glavni' + tekton 'graditelj'), a nastavak -ton ga čini sličnim prezimenu. .com, .io i .co su zauzeti; ime koriste arhitektonski biroi u Prištini i UAE.

pending_screen.story_sr: Skovano od latinskog ferrum (gvožđe) i fundere (liti), korena reči 'livnica' i engleskog 'found' (osnovati): livnica gvožđa koja i osniva. Svih 7 domena je slobodno, uključujući .com.

pending_screen.story_sr: Latinsko valor (vrednost) i -fex (tvorac), nastavak iz reči artifex (majstor), opifex i pontifex: 'tvorac vrednosti' za firmu koja pravi i poseduje ono što prodaje. Svih 7 domena je slobodno, uključujući .com.

pending_screen.story_sr: Latinsko argentum (srebro) i fund- od fundere (liti): 'livac srebra'. Zvuči kao staro nordijsko ime, a svih 7 domena je slobodno, uključujući .com.

pending_screen.story_sr: Staro-saksonsko anfelt i staroenglesko anfilt znače 'nakovanj', doslovno 'ono po čemu se udara'. Zvuči kao skandinavsko prezime; .com je zauzet, ostalih 6 slobodno.

pending_screen.name: Domifex

pending_screen.story_sr: Latinsko domi (kod kuće) i -fex (tvorac): 'onaj koji pravi kod kuće', za firmu koja živi od sopstvenih proizvoda. Isto ime nosi vuk-pauk koji sam gradi svoju 'kulu' (Geolycosa domifex).

pending_screen.name: Dextan

pending_screen.story_sr: Latinsko dexter (vešta desna ruka, koren reči 'spretnost') i nastavak -an, pa zvuči kao pravo ime. .com je zauzet, ostalih 6 slobodno, bez firmi pod tim imenom.

pending_screen.name: Amussen

pending_screen.story_sr: Latinsko amussis je rimski graditeljski lenjir, a 'ad amussim' znači 'tačno, po meri', isti 'ad' izraz kao Adacta. Sa nastavkom -sen zvuči kao prezime; .com je zauzet, ostalih 6 slobodno.

Salda.name: Salda
Salda.story: Italian 'salda' means firm and steadfast. The verb 'saldare' means to weld or solder, and Spanish 'saldar' means to settle an account, so like Braze it is a joining word: firm, welded, paid in full. Existing user: Salda UAB, a Lithuanian ventilation maker.
Salda.story_sr: Italijanski 'salda' znači čvrsta, postojana. Glagol 'saldare' znači zavariti ili zalemiti, a španski 'saldar' znači izmiriti račun, pa je to kao Braze reč o spajanju: čvrsto, zavareno, isplaćeno. Postojeći korisnik: Salda UAB, litvanski proizvođač ventilacije.

Tempra.name: Tempra
Tempra.story: Italian for the temper of steel, the heating and quenching that makes a blade hard but not brittle. Figuratively it means a person's mettle ('di buona tempra' = made of strong stuff). Existing user: Tempra Technology, a US maker of self-heating packaging.
Tempra.story_sr: Italijanski izraz za kaljenje čelika, zagrevanje i naglo hlađenje od kojih sečivo postaje tvrdo, a ne krto. U prenesenom smislu znači karakter, 'kov' čoveka ('di buona tempra' = čvrstog kova). Postojeći korisnik: Tempra Technology, američki proizvođač samozagrevajuće ambalaže.

Tenuta.name: Tenuta
Tenuta.story: Italian for an estate or landholding, from 'tenere' (to hold). Tuscan wine houses are named 'Tenuta ...' and each of their wines has its own label, the same way a quiet holding owns several separately branded products.
Tenuta.story_sr: Italijanski 'tenuta' je imanje, posed, od 'tenere' (držati). Toskanske vinarije nose ime 'Tenuta ...' i svako njihovo vino ima svoju etiketu, kao što tihi holding poseduje više proizvoda pod zasebnim brendovima.

Tarsia.name: Tarsia
Tarsia.story: Italian for intarsia, the Renaissance inlay craft in which masters fitted hundreds of pieces of different woods into one seamless picture (the studiolo in Urbino is a famous example). Many products make one crafted whole. TMview shows no live marks in classes 9 or 42 in the EU or US.
Tarsia.story_sr: Italijanski naziv za intarziju, renesansni zanat u kome su majstori slagali stotine komadića različitog drveta u jednu besprekornu sliku (poznat primer je studiolo u Urbinu). Mnogo proizvoda čini jednu majstorski složenu celinu. TMview ne pokazuje aktivne žigove u klasama 9 i 42 u EU i SAD.

Cesello.name: Cesello
Cesello.story: The Italian goldsmith's chasing chisel. 'Lavoro di cesello' means painstaking, finely detailed work, which is the standard a product company wants to be known for.
Cesello.story_sr: Italijansko zlatarsko dleto za cizeliranje, srodno našoj reči 'cizelirati'. 'Lavoro di cesello' znači pedantan, fino izrađen rad, a upravo po tom standardu firma koja pravi proizvode želi da bude poznata.

Maglio.name: Maglio
Maglio.story: Italian for the forge's heavy hammer, especially the water-driven trip hammer of old Alpine ironworks. It is also an Italian surname, so it reads like a person's name.
Maglio.story_sr: Italijanski izraz za teški kovački malj, posebno vodeni čekić starih alpskih kovačnica. Ujedno je i italijansko prezime, pa zvuči kao ime osobe.

Ottone.name: Ottone
Ottone.story: Italian for brass, the classic filler alloy used in brazing. It is also the Italian form of the name Otto (Emperor Ottone I), so it sounds like a person with a quiet metalworking story underneath.
Ottone.story_sr: Italijanski izraz za mesing, klasičnu leguru za tvrdo lemljenje. Ujedno je italijanski oblik imena Oto (car Ottone I), pa zvuči kao ime osobe, a ispod krije priču o obradi metala.

Tornio.name: Tornio
Tornio.story: Italian for lathe, the machine that makes other machines. Tornio is also a Finnish town that runs one of the world's largest stainless-steel works, so the name carries two quiet making stories.
Tornio.story_sr: Italijanski izraz za strug, mašinu koja pravi druge mašine. Tornio je i finski grad sa jednom od najvećih železara nerđajućeg čelika na svetu, pa ime nosi dve tihe priče o stvaranju.

Telaio.name: Telaio
Telaio.story: Italian for both a loom and a vehicle chassis. The punched cards of the Jacquard loom led to the computer, and a chassis is the frame on which different bodies are built, the way an umbrella brand carries its products.
Telaio.story_sr: Italijanski izraz i za razboj i za šasiju. Bušene kartice Žakarovog razboja dovele su do računara, a šasija je ram na koji se grade različite karoserije, kao što krovni brend nosi svoje proizvode.

Kontor.name: Kontor
Kontor.story: A Kontor was one of the Hanseatic League's overseas trading houses (London's Steelyard, Bergen's Bryggen, Bruges, Novgorod), small outposts that served foreign markets, which fits a Serbia-based holding that sells to the US and the EU. Existing users: Kontor Records and several IT firms named 'IT Kontor'.
Kontor.story_sr: Kontor je bio jedna od prekomorskih trgovačkih kuća Hanzeatske lige (London, Bergen, Brige, Novgorod), male ispostave koje su služile strana tržišta, što odgovara holdingu iz Srbije koji prodaje u SAD i EU. Postojeći korisnici: Kontor Records i nekoliko IT firmi pod imenom 'IT Kontor'.

Ambacht.name: Ambacht
Ambacht.story: Dutch for craft or trade, the skilled handwork passed from master to apprentice ('ambachtelijk' = artisanal). It is an old Germanic word with a firm -cht- at its core.
Ambacht.story_sr: Holandski izraz za zanat, veštinu koja se prenosi s majstora na šegrta ('ambachtelijk' = zanatski). To je stara germanska reč sa tvrdim '-cht-' u jezgru.

Skarv.name: Skarv
Skarv.story: Swedish for a splice or scarf joint, from Old Norse 'skarfr', the slanted beam end that Norse shipwrights overlapped to join timbers into one long keel. Like Braze, it tells a joining story in one hard syllable. Existing user: Skarv Technologies, a Norwegian underwater-robotics firm.
Skarv.story_sr: Švedski izraz za spoj ili nastavak (kosi tesarski spoj), od staronordijskog 'skarfr', koso odsečenog kraja grede kojim su vikinški brodograditelji spajali drvo u jednu dugu kobilicu. Kao Braze, priča o spajanju u jednom tvrdom slogu. Postojeći korisnik: Skarv Technologies, norveška firma za podvodne robote.

Smida.name: Smida
Smida.story: The Swedish verb 'to forge'. 'Smida medan järnet är varmt' is the Swedish 'strike while the iron is hot', and 'smida planer' means to forge plans. Existing user: smida.co, a leadership-strategy consultancy.
Smida.story_sr: Švedski glagol 'kovati'. 'Smida medan järnet är varmt' je švedsko 'kuj gvožđe dok je vruće', a 'smida planer' znači kovati planove. Postojeći korisnik: smida.co, konsultantska firma za liderstvo i strategiju.

Smedja.name: Smedja
Smedja.story: Swedish for smithy, the village forge where tools were made and mended for the whole district. It shares its root with English 'smith'.
Smedja.story_sr: Švedski izraz za kovačnicu, seosku radionicu u kojoj su se kovale i popravljale alatke za ceo kraj. Ima isti koren kao engleski 'smith'.

Eiga.name: Eiga
Eiga.story: Old Norse 'eiga' means to own or possess and comes from the same Germanic root as English 'own'. It is a quiet ownership story for a company that owns its products. Existing user: EIGA, a German brand-design agency.
Eiga.story_sr: Staronordijski 'eiga' znači posedovati, imati u vlasništvu, i ima isti germanski koren kao engleski 'own'. Tiha priča o vlasništvu za firmu koja poseduje svoje proizvode. Postojeći korisnik: EIGA, nemačka agencija za dizajn brenda.

Tahko.name: Tahko
Tahko.story: Finnish for grindstone, the stone wheel that sharpens every blade in the workshop. It is also a Finnish given name and a lakeside resort.
Tahko.story_sr: Finski izraz za brus, kameni točak koji naoštri svako sečivo u radionici. Takođe je finsko ime i poznato odmaralište na jezeru.

Rautio.name: Rautio
Rautio.story: An old Finnish word for blacksmith, from 'rauta' (iron). Today it is a Finnish surname, so it reads like a person's name.
Rautio.story_sr: Stara finska reč za kovača, od 'rauta' (gvožđe). Danas je finsko prezime, pa zvuči kao ime osobe.

Ahjo.name: Ahjo
Ahjo.story: Finnish for the forge hearth, where iron is heated before it is shaped. Figuratively it is the fire in which ideas are worked.
Ahjo.story_sr: Finski izraz za kovačko ognjište u kome se gvožđe zagreva pre oblikovanja. U prenesenom smislu to je vatra u kojoj se ideje kuju.

Cadarn.name: Cadarn
Cadarn.story: Welsh for strong, sturdy and steadfast. It is a Celtic word told to the world the way Mistral carries Provence, and TMview shows no live marks in classes 9 or 42.
Cadarn.story_sr: Velški izraz za snažan, čvrst i postojan. To je keltska reč ispričana svetu, kao što Mistral nosi Provansu, a TMview ne pokazuje aktivne žigove u klasama 9 i 42.

Saer.name: Saer
Saer.story: Welsh for craftsman or builder ('saer coed' = carpenter, 'saer maen' = stonemason). It has four letters and one syllable. Existing user: SAER, an Italian pump maker.
Saer.story_sr: Velški izraz za majstora, graditelja ('saer coed' = stolar, 'saer maen' = kamenorezac). Ima četiri slova i jedan slog. Postojeći korisnik: SAER, italijanski proizvođač pumpi.

Crisol.name: Crisol
Crisol.story: Spanish and Portuguese for crucible, the vessel in which metals are melted and refined. Figuratively it is a proving ground where things are tested by fire. Existing users: a consulting firm and a video-game title.
Crisol.story_sr: Španski i portugalski izraz za topionički lonac (tigl) u kome se metali tope i pročišćavaju. U prenesenom smislu to je mesto provere, iskušenje vatrom. Postojeći korisnici: jedna konsultantska firma i jedna video-igra.

Troquel.name: Troquel
Troquel.story: Spanish for the steel die that stamps or cuts a shape, the master form from which every copy is struck. It fits a company that builds a product once and ships it many times.
Troquel.story_sr: Španski izraz za čelični kalup (matricu) za utiskivanje i isecanje, glavni oblik iz koga se otiskuje svaki primerak. Pristaje firmi koja proizvod napravi jednom, a isporučuje ga mnogo puta.

Bigorna.name: Bigorna
Bigorna.story: Portuguese for anvil, the fixed block on which everything in the forge gets shaped. The hard -g- and -rn- give the name weight.
Bigorna.story_sr: Portugalski izraz za nakovanj, čvrsti blok na kome se u kovačnici sve oblikuje. Tvrdo 'g' i 'rn' daju imenu težinu.

Etabli.name: Etabli
Etabli.story: French 'établi' is the joiner's workbench, and the same word also means 'established'. One word holds both the workshop and the standing.
Etabli.story_sr: Francuski 'établi' je stolarski radni sto, a ista reč znači i 'osnovan, ustanovljen'. U jednoj reči su i radionica i ugled.

Tetsu.name: Tetsu
Tetsu.story: Japanese for iron (鉄), the raw metal behind the Japanese sword. It has two short syllables with hard T sounds and reads like a name.
Tetsu.story_sr: Japanski izraz za gvožđe (鉄), sirovi metal od koga nastaje japanski mač. Ima dva kratka sloga sa tvrdim 't' zvucima i zvuči kao ime.

Yosegi.name: Yosegi
Yosegi.story: Japanese marquetry from Hakone (yosegi-zaiku): woods of different natural colors are glued into one patterned block, then shaved into thin sheets that all carry the pattern. One block yields many products. Existing user: a Yahoo Japan open-source storage format.
Yosegi.story_sr: Japanska intarzija iz Hakonea (yosegi-zaiku): drvo različitih prirodnih boja slepi se u jedan šaren blok, pa se rendiše u tanke listove koji svi nose istu šaru. Iz jednog bloka nastaje mnogo proizvoda. Postojeći korisnik: open-source format za skladištenje podataka kompanije Yahoo Japan.

Urushi.name: Urushi
Urushi.story: Japanese lacquer made from urushi-tree sap and applied in many thin coats. Lacquered pieces last for centuries, and some found in Japan are about 9,000 years old: patient layering that endures.
Urushi.story_sr: Japanski lak od soka drveta urushi koji se nanosi u mnogo tankih slojeva. Lakirani predmeti traju vekovima, a neki pronađeni u Japanu stari su oko 9.000 godina: strpljivo slojevanje koje traje.

Kiwame.name: Kiwame
Kiwame.story: Japanese for mastery or reaching the utmost (極め). A 'kiwame' is also an appraiser's attribution certifying an old sword or artwork as genuine (kiwame-fuda), so the name joins mastery and a mark of authenticity. Existing user: Kiwame Tokyo, a watch microbrand.
Kiwame.story_sr: Japanski izraz za majstorstvo, dostizanje vrhunca (極め). 'Kiwame' je i procenjivačeva potvrda da je stari mač ili umetničko delo autentično (kiwame-fuda), pa ime spaja majstorstvo i pečat autentičnosti. Postojeći korisnik: Kiwame Tokyo, mali brend satova.
